classes.name: BBjServletData
classes.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, the BBjServletData object
allows your program to register callbacks for incoming web requests.

When the webserver first receives a request registered
with the [BBjServletRegistry](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjservletregistry/bbjservletregistry.htm),
an interpreter will be started with the registered [BBjAppConfig](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/bbjappconfig.htm).
That application then registers handlers for callback events. BBjServletData
provides a handle to the internal configuration for registering callbacks.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjservletdata/bbjservletdata.htm)

methods.name: getServerOSName

classes.name: BBjInterpreter
classes.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher the `BBjInterpreter` object provides access to selected BBj interpreter functionality through a Java API. This allows Java code to invoke interpreter-level operations such as executing BBj commands, calling BBj programs, and managing interpreter behavior without direct access to the BBj language.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter.htm)

methods.name: isInterpreterContext
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher determines whether the current thread is executing within the [BBjInterpreter](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter.htm) context.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter_isInterpreterContext.htm)

methods.name: executeInInterpreterContext
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher executes a Java Callable in the [BBjInterpreter](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter.htm) context. If called from the interpreter thread, the Callable executes immediately; otherwise, it is dispatched to the interpreter context and executed asynchronously, a BBjException is thrown if the Callable cannot be dispatched to the interpreter context or if execution fails.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter_executeInInterpreterContext.htm)

methods.name: processEvents
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher processes BBj events and blocks until all pending events have been handled. This method behaves like the BBj [PROCESS_EVENTS](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/commands/process_events_verb.htm) verb.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter_processEvents.htm)

methods.name: processPendingEvents
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher processes all pending BBj events without blocking, except for the time required to execute event callbacks.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter_processPendingEvents.htm)

methods.name: waitVerb
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher causes the [BBjInterpreter](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter.htm) to wait for the specified fractional number of seconds. This method behaves like the BBj [WAIT](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/commands/bbj-commands/wait_verb_bbj.htm) verb.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter_waitVerb.htm)

methods.name: eval
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, evaluates the specified BBj command string in the [BBjInterpreter](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter.htm) context and returns the result. This method behaves like the BBj [EVAL](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/commands/EVAL()_Function_Evaluate_Expression.htm) function. A BBjException is thrown if the command cannot be evaluated or execution fails.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter_eval.htm)

methods.name: call
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher calls a BBj program with the specified arguments in the [BBjInterpreter](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter.htm) context and returns the updated argument values. This method behaves like the BBj [CALL](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/commands/bbj-commands/call_verb_bbj.htm) verb. A BBjException is thrown if the program cannot be executed or execution fails.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter_call.htm)

methods.name: release
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher exits the [BBjInterpreter](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter.htm). When no exit value is specified, the interpreter exits with a status of **0**. This method behaves like the BBj [RELEASE](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/commands/bbj-commands/release_verb_bbj.htm) verb with no arguments. A BBjException is thrown if the interpreter cannot be released.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter_release.htm)

methods.name: release
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher exits the [BBjInterpreter](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter.htm). When no exit value is specified, the interpreter exits with a status of **0**. This method behaves like the BBj [RELEASE](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/commands/bbj-commands/release_verb_bbj.htm) verb with no arguments. A BBjException is thrown if the interpreter cannot be released.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter_release.htm)

methods.name: setEsc
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher sets the escape handler to an object method that takes no arguments. The [BBjinterpreter](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter.htm) automatically performs a `RETRY` when the method returns normally. If this behavior is not desired, the method should either call `RELEASE` or throw an exception. Setting object to **null** will clear the BBj `SETESC`.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter_setEsc.htm)

methods.name: setErr
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher sets the error handler to an object method that takes no arguments. The [BBjInterpreter](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter.htm) automatically performs a **RETRY** when the method returns normally. If this behavior is not desired, the method should either call **RELEASE** or throw an exception. Setting the object to `null` will clear the BBj `SETERR`.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter_setErr.htm)

classes.name: BBjFileSave
classes.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, the BBjFileSave object is equivalent to the [FILESAVE() Function - Create File Save Dialog](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/commands/filesave_function_create_a_file_save_dialog.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjFileSave/BBjFileSave.htm)

methods.name: ext

methods.name: filters
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method sets one or more file filters that the user can select from.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjFileSave/BBjFileSave_filters.htm)

methods.name: mode

methods.name: modes
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method sets assorted options on this BBjFileSave dialog, corresponding to the **MODE= option** of the [FILESAVE() Function ](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/commands/filesave_function_create_a_file_save_dialog.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjFileSave/BBjFileSave_modes.htm)

methods.name: name
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method sets the default filename for this [BBjFileSave](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjFileSave/BBjFileSave.htm) dialog.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjFileSave/BBjFileSave_name.htm)

methods.name: path

methods.name: title

classes.name: BBjPrompt
classes.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, the BBjPrompt object is equivalent to the [PROMPT() Function - Prompt For String Value](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/commands/prompt_function.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjPrompt/BBjPrompt.htm)

methods.name: init

methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method sets the message text or HTML for this [BBjPrompt](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjPrompt/BBjPrompt.htm) dialog.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjPrompt/BBjPrompt_message.htm)

methods.name: modes
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method sets assorted options on this BBjPrompt, corresponding to the `MODE=` option of the [PROMPT() function](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/commands/prompt_function.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjPrompt/BBjPrompt_modes.htm)

methods.name: options
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method sets assorted options on this [BBjPrompt](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjPrompt/BBjPrompt.htm), corresponding to the int expr parameter of the [PROMPT() function](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/commands/prompt_function.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjPrompt/BBjPrompt_options.htm)

methods.name: show
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method shows the [BBjPrompt](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjPrompt/BBjPrompt.htm) dialog, waits for the user to type a value, then returns that string to the application. If the user cancels the dialog by clicking **Cancel** or pressing **Esc**, it returns "**::CANCEL::**".[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjPrompt/BBjPrompt_show.htm)

methods.name: timeout
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method sets the [BBjPrompt](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjPrompt/BBjPrompt.htm) timeout in seconds. If not specified, the BBjPrompt will wait indefinitely for the user to make a selection.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjPrompt/BBjPrompt_timeout.htm)

methods.name: title
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method sets the title text for this [BBjPrompt](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjPrompt/BBjPrompt.htm) dialog.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjPrompt/BBjPrompt_title.htm)

classes.name: BBjServletConfiguration
classes.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, BBj Servlets can be programmatically configured though the
AdminAPI.

This class is used to configure a BBjServlet that will be automatically
deployed within a [BBjJettyContextConfiguration](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettycontextconfiguration/BBjJettyContextConfiguration.htm). The configuration
comprises 3 elements

- NAME - will form part of the URL
- PROGRAM - the source file containing the servlet code
- CONFIG - the BBj configuration file to use during execution[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjservletconfiguration/BBjServletConfiguration.htm)

methods.name: setConfig
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method sets the name
of the config file used in executing a [BBj
Servlet](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/usr/BBj_Components/BBjServices/Web_Server/BBjServlet_overview.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjservletconfiguration/BBjServletConfiguration_setConfig.htm)

methods.name: getConfig
methods.docu:

Servlet](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/usr/BBj_Components/BBjServices/Web_Server/BBjServlet_overview.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjservletconfiguration/BBjServletConfiguration_getConfig.htm)

methods.name: setProgram
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method sets the name
of the program file used in executing a [BBj
Servlet](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/usr/BBj_Components/BBjServices/Web_Server/BBjServlet_overview.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjservletconfiguration/BBjServletConfiguration_setProgram.htm)

methods.name: getProgram
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method gets the
name of the program file used in executing a [BBj
Servlet](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/usr/BBj_Components/BBjServices/Web_Server/BBjServlet_overview.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjservletconfiguration/BBjServletConfiguration_getProgram.htm)

methods.name: getName
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method gets the

classes.name: BBjResourceUrl
classes.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, a BBjResourceUrl uniquely identifies a resource
used by a BUI application.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjresourceurl/BBjResourceUrl.html)

methods.name: getAppUrl
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the unique URL corresponding to this resource.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjresourceurl/BBjResourceUrl_getAppUrl.html)

methods.name: getMimeType
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the MIME type of this resource.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjresourceurl/BBjResourceUrl_getMimeType.html)

methods.name: getSourceFileName
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the filename from which the contents of this URL were obtained.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjresourceurl/BBjResourceUrl_getSourceFileName.html)

methods.name: setMimeType
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, this methods sets the MIME type of this resource.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjresourceurl/BBjResourceUrl_setMimeType.html)

methods.name: setSourceFileName
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method sets the file from which the contents
of this URL were obtained. This method will re-read the file given here
and cause [BBjResourceUrl::getAppUrl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjresourceurl/BBjResourceUrl_getAppUrl.html)
to return a new value if the file contents differ.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjresourceurl/BBjResourceUrl_setSourceFileName.html)

classes.name: BBjFileUpload
classes.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, BBjFileUpload contains
all of the information related to files uploaded to a Servlet.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjfileupload/BBjFileUpload.htm)

methods.name: getFieldName
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns the name of the HTML element
posted to the servlet with a [BBjFileUpload](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjfileupload/BBjFileUpload.htm)
object.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjfileupload/BBjFileUpload_getFieldName.htm)

methods.name: getTempName
getContentType
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns the mime type of the uploaded
file in a [BBjFileUpload](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjfileupload/BBjFileUpload.htm) object.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjfileupload/BBjFileUpload_getContentType.htm)

methods.name: getContentLength
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns the length (in bytes) of
the file uploaded in a [BBjFileUpload](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjfileupload/BBjFileUpload.htm)
object.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjfileupload/BBjFileUpload_getContentLength.htm)

methods.name: getOriginalName
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns the original file name from
a [BBjFileUpload](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjfileupload/BBjFileUpload.htm) object.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjfileupload/BBjFileUpload_getOriginalName.htm)

classes.name: BBjPrinter
classes.docu: In BBj 4.00 and higher, a BBjPrinter object allows the user to select a printer and start printing.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjprinter/bbjprinter.htm)

methods.name: getForm
methods.docu: In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method obtains a [BBjForm](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjform/bbjform.htm) object for the currently selected printer.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjprinter/bbjprinter_getform.htm)

methods.name: setNative
methods.docu: In BBj 15.12 and higher, this method sets whether or not the native printer driver is used.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjprinter/BBjPrinter_setNative.htm)

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.docu: In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method sets the `javax.print.attribute.PrintRequest` attributes for documents.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjprinter/bbjprinter_setattributes.htm)

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.docu: Obtains the user set of `javax.print.attribute.PrintRequest` attributes for the documents.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjprinter/bbjprinter_getattributes.htm)

methods.name: getNonStandardAttribute
methods.docu: create a special platform specific attribute.

classes.name: BBjRuntime
classes.docu:
In BBj 9.00 and higher, BBjRuntime provides methods through which a program
may interact with its runtime environment.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjruntime/bbjruntime.htm)

methods.name: doGC
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method causes the JVM to do a garbage collection.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjruntime/bbjruntime_dogc.htm)

methods.name: getBBjStack
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method returns a [BBjVector](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjvector/bbjvector.htm) of [BBjStackElement](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjstackelement/bbjstackelement.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjruntime/bbjruntime_getbbjstack.htm)

methods.name: getBBjStackTrace
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method returns a string representing the BBj stack trace.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjruntime/bbjruntime_getbbjstacktrace.htm)

methods.name: getDebugState
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method returns whether the debug state of the current interpreter is on.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjruntime/bbjruntime_getdebugstate.htm)

methods.name: getMemStatString
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method returns a string containing information about the current memory usage of the JVM.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjruntime/bbjruntime_getmemstatstring.htm)

methods.name: getClientMemoryString
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method returns a string containing information about the current
memory usage of the client JVM.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjruntime/BBjRuntime_getClientMemoryString.htm)

methods.name: isClientInServerJVM
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method returns whether the client is running in the same JVM as the server.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjruntime/bbjruntime_isclientinserverjvm.htm)

methods.name: isDVKLicenseActive
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method returns whether BBjServices is using a DVK (development kit) license.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjruntime/bbjruntime_isdvklicenseactive.htm)

methods.name: setDebugState
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method sets the debug state of the current interpreter.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjruntime/bbjruntime_setdebugstate.htm)

methods.name: isDebugging
methods.docu:
Returns whether the interpreter is being run in a debugger.

**Returns:** true if this interpreter is being run in a debugger,
false otherwise.

methods.name: isConsoleInteractive
methods.docu: In BBj 13.00 and higher, this method returns whether the console in this BBj session is capable of providing a READY prompt to the user. If this method returns true, if the program executes an ESCAPE or if the program encounters an uncaught error, it will attempt to print the READY prompt, subject to the constraints defined by STBL("!CONEXIT"). If this method returns false, executing an ESCAPE or encountering an uncaught error will cause this BBj session to terminate.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjruntime/bbjruntime_isconsoleinteractive.htm)

classes.name: BBjBuiNoneCloseAction
classes.docu: In BBj 14.00 and higher, the BBjBuiNoneCloseAction object provides an interface to configure no action on termination of a BUI or DWC application.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiNoneCloseAction/BBjBuiNoneCloseAction.htm)

methods.name: getActionType
methods.docu: In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns an integer constant identifying the type of this close action (ACTION_NONE).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiNoneCloseAction/BBjBuiNoneCloseAction_getActionType.htm)

methods.name: getActionTypeString
methods.docu: In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns an string constant identifying the type of this close action (ACTION_NONE).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiNoneCloseAction/BBjBuiNoneCloseAction_getActionTypeString.htm)

classes.name: BBjConfig
classes.docu:
A BBjConfig object provides programmatic access to some configuration
items.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig.htm)

methods.name: getCommandLineObject
methods.docu: In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method returns a BBjCommandLineObject.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_getcommandlineobject.htm)

methods.name: getCommandLineObject
methods.docu: In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method returns a BBjCommandLineObject.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_getcommandlineobject.htm)

methods.name: getCompatibilitySetting
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method retrieves !COMPAT values from [STBL() functions](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/usr/BBj_Enhancements/stbl_formats_bbj.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_getcompatibilitysetting.htm)

methods.name: getConfigFileName
methods.docu: In BBj 2.02 and higher, this method returns the name of the configuration file used by the current Interpreter session.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_getconfigfilename.htm)

methods.name: getCurrentCommandLineObject
methods.docu: In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method returns the current session's BBjCommandLineObject.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_getcurrentcommandlineobject.htm)

methods.name: getOptionSetting
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method retrieves !OPTIONS values from [STBL() functions](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/usr/BBj_Enhancements/stbl_formats_bbj.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_getoptionsetting.htm)

methods.name: getSuppressErrorsOnClientObjVoidMethods
methods.docu: In BBj 8.00 and higher, this method returns a value indicating whether the Interpreter waits for completion of ClientObject methods that have void return type. If the Interpreter does not wait for completion then any exception that is generated on the client side during the method execution will not generate an error in the users program.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_getsuppresserrorsonclientobjvoidmethods.htm)

methods.name: isClientCentric
methods.docu: In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method returns the client centric SETOPTS bit (8,$08$).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_isclientcentric.htm)

methods.name: isReleaseOnLostConnection
methods.docu:
In BBj 2.01 and higher, this method returns
a boolean value that indicates whether the interpreter session will be
terminated immediately if the client side of a thin client connection
dies unexpectedly.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/BBjConfig_isReleaseOnLostConnection.htm)

methods.name: makeEmptyAppConfig
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns a [BBjAppConfig](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/bbjappconfig.htm) object, which can be used to build and publish a BUI [BBjApplication](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/bbjapplication.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/BBjConfig_makeEmptyAppConfig.htm)

methods.name: notifyUserOnInternalError
methods.docu: In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method controls whether the interpreter notifies the user when it encounters an internal [!ERROR=255](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/usr/Errors/_error_255.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_notifyuseroninternalerror.htm)

methods.name: releaseOnLostConnection
methods.docu: In BBj 2.01 and higher, this method controls whether to terminate the Interpreter session immediately if the client side of a thin client connection dies unexpectedly.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_releaseonlostconnection.htm)

methods.name: requireAllSendMsgResponses
methods.docu: This method controls whether the Interpreter waits for a response from certain SENDMSG functions before proceeding with the next program statement.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_requireallsendmsgresponses.htm)

methods.name: setClientCentric
methods.docu: In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method sets the SETOPTS bit 8,$08$.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_setclientcentric.htm)

methods.name: setCompatibilitySetting
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method sets !COMPAT values from [STBL() functions](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/usr/BBj_Enhancements/stbl_formats_bbj.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_setcompatibilitysetting.htm)

methods.name: setOptionSetting
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method sets !OPTIONS values from [STBL() functions](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/usr/BBj_Enhancements/stbl_formats_bbj.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_setoptionsetting.htm)

methods.name: suppressErrorsOnClientObjVoidMethods
methods.docu: In BBj 8.00 and higher, this method controls whether the Interpreter waits for completion of ClientObject methods that have void return type. If the Interpreter does not wait for completion then any exception that is generated on the client side during the method execution will not generate an error in the users program.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_suppresserrorsonclientobjvoidmethods.htm)

methods.name: suppressPrinterAckBack
methods.docu: Controls whether the Interpreter waits for a response from the printer before processing the next program statement.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_suppressprinterackback.htm)

methods.name: suppressUIAckBack
methods.docu: Controls whether the Interpreter waits for a response from UI before processing the next program statement.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_suppressuiackback.htm)

methods.name: unpinSession
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this [BBjConfig](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig.htm) method unpins all the programs and resources in a given session. Loading these programs or resources again causes BBj to check their timestamp and load a new version on disk, if the timestamp has changed.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_unpinsession.htm)

methods.name: unpinSessionEntity
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this [BBjConfig](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig.htm) method unpins the specified program or resource. Loading this program or resource again causes BBj to check its timestamp and load a new version on disk, if the timestamp has changed.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_unpinsessionentity.htm)

methods.name: env
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method returns the value of the specified server operating system environment variable. Unlike the [ENV](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/commands/bbj-commands/env_function_bbj.htm) function in the language, it does not depend on whether the interpreter is client-centric.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_env.htm)

methods.name: clientEnv
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method returns the value of the specified client operating system environment variable. It throws a BBjException if the variable does not exist.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_clientEnv.htm)

classes.name: BBjJettyServerConfiguration
classes.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher this class is used to configure the integrated Jetty
Server.

It provides an interface to maintain contexts through the
[BBjJettyContextConfiguration](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettycontextconfiguration/BBjJettyContextConfiguration.htm) class.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration.htm)

methods.name: createCustomContext
methods.docu: In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method creates a new Context entry in the Jetty web server.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration_createCustomContext.htm)

methods.name: getCustomContext
methods.docu: In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method gets a [BBjJettyContextConfiguration](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettycontextconfiguration/BBjJettyContextConfiguration.htm) for the name's context.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration_getCustomContext.htm)

methods.name: removeCustomContext
methods.docu: In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method removes a Context Entry from the internal Jetty web server.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration_removeCustomContext.htm)

methods.name: getContextNames
methods.docu: In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method returns a [BBjVector](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjvector/bbjvector.htm)containing the names of the contexts configured in the Jetty web server.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration_getContextNames.htm)

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.docu: In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method saves the configuration to basis_home/cfg/jetty.xml, overwriting the existing file.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration_saveConfig.htm)

methods.name: getRootContextInfo
methods.docu: In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method gets a [BBjJettyContextConfiguration](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettycontextconfiguration/BBjJettyContextConfiguration.htm) for the default BBj context.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration_getRootContextInfo.htm)

methods.name: getEmContextInfo
methods.docu: In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method gets a [BBjJettyContextConfiguration](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettycontextconfiguration/BBjJettyContextConfiguration.htm) for the Enterprise Manager context.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration_getEmContextInfo.htm)

methods.name: setAdminUser
methods.docu: In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method sets the admin user stored in `jetty.xml`.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration_setAdminUser.htm)

methods.name: setAdminPassword
methods.docu: In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method sets the admin password stored in `jetty.xml`.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration_setAdminPassword.htm)

methods.name: addMimeType
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method adds a [MIME type](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Guides/MIME_types) to jetty.xml.

MIME types are stored as `mime-type` elements in jetty.xml and are applicable to all contexts.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration_addMimeType.htm)

methods.name: removeMimeType
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method removes a [MIME type](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Guides/MIME_types) from jetty.xml.

MIME types are stored as `mime-type` elements in jetty.xml and are applicable to all contexts.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration_removeMimeType.htm)

methods.name: getMimeTypes
methods.docu:

classes.name: BBjForm
classes.docu:
In BBj 4.00 and higher, the BBjForm object allows users to build and
print a document on the associated printer.

The BBjForm API provides an object-oriented interface for building forms
and reports for printing. It provides a good substitute for using [SYSPRINT](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/inst/sysprint_printing.htm)
and [PWINDOW](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/mnemonic/print/pwindow_mn_print_window.htm) for
form building. SYSPRINT allows programmers to lay out a form, but requires
everything to be explicit. It does not provide any abstraction. PWINDOW
provides good abstraction, but the controls are focused more on the needs
of a GUI rather than a printed form. The BBjForm API overcomes the shortcomings
and limitations of both of these approaches by making available an object-oriented
API specifically designed for laying out printed forms and reports.

There is a clear path for using the BBjForm API. First, get the correct
printer from BBjAPI and set the appropriate printer options on the resulting
BBjPrinter object. Next, obtain a BBjForm object that represents a single
printed form, allowing creation of one or more pages of the form. The
programmer can lay out each page independently by creating BBjForm objects,
setting their attributes, and adding them to the page. When the form is
completed, use BBjForm methods to print, preview, or cancel the form.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjform/bbjform.htm)

methods.name: savePDF
methods.docu:
In BBj 26.00 and higher, these methods save the current [BBjForm](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjform/bbjform.htm) as a PDF file. They save the form content directly to a PDF document based on the form’s state at the time the method is executed.

These methods support creating either a standard PDF file or a password-protected PDF file. When security is applied, the generated PDF can include passwords that control access to the document, such as requiring a password to open the file or restricting editing permissions. This allows applications to generate PDF output from a form and optionally apply access restrictions to the resulting document. See: [getBBjPDFForm](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjapi/bbjapi_getbbjpdfform.htm)[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjform/bbjform_savePDF.htm)

classes.name: BBjNamespace
classes.docu:
In BBj 3.00 and higher, BBjNamespace provides a mechanism
by which two or more BBj programs that are running in the same BBjServices
can share data. It also provides methods that allow a program to be notified
when that shared data is modified by some other program.

There are three types of BBjNamespaces, each with their own naming convention,
level of visibility, and life cycle, with differences in scope and de-allocation
of the shared memory.

- Generic BBjNamespace - scope is global;
memory is automatically freed when
there are no longer any references.
- Group BBjNamespace - scope is parent-children
(group) interpreter (SCALLED or newBBjSession())
sessions; memory is automatically de-allocated when the group no longer
exists
- Global BBjNamespace - scope is global
BBjServices or JVM wide; de-allocation only happens when items are
removed from the namespace or restart of BBjServices (no automatic
de-allocation)[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjnamespace/bbjnamespace.htm)

classes.name: BBjRecordSet
classes.docu:
In BBj 4.00 and higher, a BBjRecordSet represents the set of records
from a data file or SQL SELECT command. The BBjRecordSet maintains a pointer
to the current record ([BBjRecordData](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjrecorddata/bbjrecorddata.htm))
with methods to insert, update, delete, and move between records. A record
set is often bound to one or more data-aware GUI controls. See [Interface
RecordSetBindable::bindRecordSet](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjinterfaces/IF_RecordSetBindable/interface_recordsetbindable_bindrecordset.htm) for more information.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjrecordset/bbjrecordset.htm)

methods.name: getMessage
methods.docu: In BBj 23 and higher, this method returns the default [BBjSessionInfo](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjsessioninfo/bbjsessioninfo.htm) message specified by the [BBjCommandLineObject](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjcommandlineobject/bbjcommandlineobject.htm), or null() if none was specified.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjcommandlineobject/BBjCommandLineObject_getMessage.htm)

classes.name: BaseContext
classes.docu:
The BaseContext interface forms the base for objects that require
attribute data.

methods.name: getAttributeNames
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.10 and higher, this method returns the names of attributes in
the context.

**Returns:** BBlVector

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.12 and higher, this method is used to get the attribute
specified.

**Parameters:**

- `name` The name of the required attribute

**Returns:** the object bound to the specified name

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.12 and higher, this method is used to set bind an attribute
value to a name.

**Parameters:**

- `name` the name to use in binding
- `value` the value of to be bound

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.12 and higher, this method is used to remove the attribute bound
to the specified name.

**Parameters:**

- `name` The name of the object to remove

methods.name: contains
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.12 and higher, this method tests to see if the specified
attribute exists.

**Parameters:**

- `name`

**Returns:** a boolean value indicating if the specified name exists.

classes.name: BBjAdmin
classes.docu:
In BBj 5.00 and higher, the BBjAdmin object provides programmatic
access to the global BBjServices configuration. This may affect other
BBj clients.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjadmin/bbjadmin.htm)

methods.name: addUser
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method adds a user.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjadmin/bbjadmin_adduser.htm)

methods.name: changePassword
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method changes the password for a given user.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjadmin/bbjadmin_changepassword.htm)

methods.name: getDatabaseGlobal
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method gets the specified database property value.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjadmin/bbjadmin_getdatabaseglobal.htm)

methods.name: getEnvironment
methods.docu: In BBj 5.00 and higher, this method retrieves the [BBjAdminEnvironment](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjadminenvironment/bbjadminenvironment.htm) object.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjadmin/bbjadmin_getenvironment.htm)

methods.name: getJdbcOdbcConnections
methods.docu: In BBj 8.00 and higher, this method retrieves a [BBjVector](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjvector/bbjvector.htm) of [BBjJdbcOdbcInfo](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjdbcodbcinfo/bbjjdbcodbcinfo.htm) objects; one for each JDBC or ODBC connection that is currently open. This does NOT include open SQL channels or RecordSet objects unless they are open from a remote interpreter.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjadmin/bbjadmin_getjdbcodbcconnections.htm)

methods.name: getOpenFileInfos
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method retrieves a [BBjVector](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjvector/bbjvector.htm) of [BBjOpenFileInfo](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjopenfileinfo/bbjopenfileinfo.htm) object; one for each file that is currently open.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjadmin/bbjadmin_getopenfileinfos.htm)

methods.name: getPermission
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns an indication of whether a user has a permission.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjadmin/bbjadmin_getpermission.htm)

methods.name: getQueryAnalysisInfo
methods.docu:
This
method is used strictly by BASIS admin tools. This information is
available in a human readable user interface in the Enterprise Manager
on the Query Analysis tab of the table editors.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjadmin/BBjAdmin_getQueryAnalysisInfo.htm)

methods.name: getServletRegistry
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and a [BBjServletRegistry](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjservletregistry/bbjservletregistry.htm)
object which is used to publish and unpublish servlets to the web server.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjadmin/BBjAdmin_getServletRegistry.htm)

methods.name: getWebAppServer
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the [BBjAppServer](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver.html),
which is used to publish and administer BUI applications.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjadmin/BBjAdmin_getWebAppServer.htm)

methods.name: release
methods.docu:
Cleans up and releases the resources used
by the [BBjAdmin](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjadmin/bbjadmin.htm) instance.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjadmin/BBjAdmin_release.htm)

methods.name: reloadDBConfig
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method reloads the config.ini file without requiring a restart of BBjServices. The config.ini file contains database configuration information for all databases available to BBjServices.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjadmin/bbjadmin_reloaddbconfig.htm)

methods.name: removeDatabaseGlobal
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method removes the specified database property.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjadmin/BBjAdmin_removeDatabaseGlobal.htm)

methods.name: removeUser
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method removes a user from the system.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjadmin/bbjadmin_removeuser.htm)

methods.name: setDatabaseGlobal
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method sets the specified database property to the specified value.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjadmin/bbjadmin_setdatabaseglobal.htm)

methods.name: setPermission
methods.docu: In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method sets a permission for a user.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjadmin/bbjadmin_setpermission.htm)

methods.name: getJettyServer
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method gets the [BBjJettyServer](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserver/BBjJettyServer.htm)
to allow programmatic control
of the integrated Jetty Server.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjadmin/BBjAdmin_getJettyServer.htm)

methods.name: getJettyServerConfig
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method enables the [BBjJettyServerConfiguration](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration.htm)
to allow programmatic configuration
of the integrated Jetty Server.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjadmin/BBjAdmin_getJettyServerConfig.htm)

methods.name: makeWebserviceClient
methods.docu:
In BBj 16.0 and higher, this method will auto-generate a BBj Web-Service client.

It will generate all the java classes required and a BBj program that can
be used as a starting point in writing your client application.

**Parameters:**

- `wsdl` The location or URL to a WSDL file
- `destination` where to write the client files
- `jarName` name of jar file to create

classes.name: BBjTriggerData
classes.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, BBjTriggerData provides access to the running
trigger.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/BBjTriggerData/bbjtriggerdata.htm)

methods.name: getAllowOverwrite
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, if no key was specified in a Write Trigger, this
method indicates whether write will overwrite or throw an error.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/BBjTriggerData/bbjtriggerdata_getallowoverwrite.htm)

methods.name: getDirection
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method the DIR option's value.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/BBjTriggerData/bbjtriggerdata_getdirection.htm)

methods.name: getDOM
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method indicates whether the VERB resulting
in this Trigger had a DOM= branch.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/BBjTriggerData/bbjtriggerdata_getdom.htm)

methods.name: getExpectedDiskData
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher and in an Update Trigger, this method returns
the expected record value currently on disk before the update occurs.
The expected disk data must match the actual data on disk or an error
is generated when the file system attempts to update the record on disk.

This value is empty for Triggers fired by a WRITE RECORD call in the
language. The value is only relevant during SQL UPDATE statements and
calls to the update() methods on JLIB FilePosition instances.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/BBjTriggerData/bbjtriggerdata_getexpecteddiskdata.htm)

methods.name: getExtract
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method indicates whether the read operation
occurred as a result of an EXTRACT call.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/BBjTriggerData/bbjtriggerdata_getextract.htm)

methods.name: getField
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns whether the FileSystem should
perform Field Terminated reads when reading a string file.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/BBjTriggerData/bbjtriggerdata_getfield.htm)

methods.name: getFileComment

methods.name: createMemoryRecordSet
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method creates a record set in memory that behaves in the same way as an SQL record set. A memory record set allows the developer to create a record set from a string template and then populate that template with data as they see fit.

One of the most common uses for memory record sets is in [stored procedures](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/usr/dbms/storedproceduresoverview.htm) because stored procedures often need to return an SQL result set to the client application. A memory record set gives the developer the ability to create a record set (that the SQL engine later converts to a result set), populate this record set with arbitrary data, and return the record set as the result of the stored procedure call.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjapi/bbjapi_creatememoryrecordset.htm)

methods.name: getEventData
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method returns
a [BBjEventData](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjeventdata/BBjEventData.htm) object when
used exclusively inside an administrative event handler program. The administration
server (part of BBjServices) calls this special type of event handler
program when the administrator configures an event handler using the Enterprise
Manager or Admin API. Outside an event handler program, this method returns
null.

Note:

The code in the event handler program
runs on the server, in a background process and does not have access to
any UI components or console.

See [Event
Handlers](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/em/bbjservices/EM_BS_Event_Handlers.htm)
in the Enterprise
Manager for more information about configuring event handlers.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjapi/BBjAPI_getEventData.htm)

methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method sets the selection mode (files, directories, or both) for this [BBjFileOpen](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjFileOpen/BBjFileOpen.htm) dialog.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjFileOpen/BBjFileOpen_mode.htm)

methods.name: modes
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method sets assorted options on this [BBjFileOpen](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjFileOpen/BBjFileOpen.htm) dialog, corresponding to the **MODE= option** of the [FILEOPEN() Function](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/commands/fileopen_function_create_file_open_dialog.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjFileOpen/BBjFileOpen-modes.htm)

methods.name: name
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method sets the default filename for this dialog.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjFileOpen/BBjFileOpen_name.htm)

methods.name: path
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method sets the default directory for this [BBjFileOpen](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjFileOpen/BBjFileOpen.htm) dialog.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjFileOpen/BBjFileOpen_path.htm)

methods.name: show
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method shows the [BBjFileOpen](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjFileOpen/BBjFileOpen.htm) dialog and waits for the user to make a selection.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjFileOpen/BBjFileOpen_show.htm)

methods.name: title
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method sets the title of this [BBjFileOpen](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjFileOpen/BBjFileOpen.htm) dialog.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjFileOpen/BBjFileOpen_title.htm)

classes.name: BBjBuiMsgCloseAction
classes.docu: In BBj 14.00 and higher, the BBjBuiMsgCloseAction object provides an interface to display a message on termination of a BUI or DWC application.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiMsgCloseAction/BBjBuiMsgCloseAction.htm)

methods.name: getActionType
methods.docu: In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns an integer constant identifying the type of this close action (ACTION_MSG).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiMsgCloseAction/BBjBuiMsgCloseAction_getActionType.htm)

methods.name: getActionTypeString
methods.docu: In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns a string constant identifying the type of this close action (ACTION_MSG).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiMsgCloseAction/BBjBuiMsgCloseAction_getActionTypeString.htm)

methods.name: getMessage
methods.docu: In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns the text message from this close action.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiMsgCloseAction/bbjbuimsgcloseAction_getmessage.htm)

classes.name: BBjKeySegment
classes.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, BBjKeySegment objects are used
to construct [BBjKeyInfo](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjkeyinfo/bbjkeyinfo.htm) objects. BBjKeyInfo
objects can be used to manipulate VKEYED file key chains dynamically.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjkeysegment/bbjkeysegment.htm)

methods.name: getField
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns the field number of a [BBjKeySegment](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjkeysegment/bbjkeysegment.htm) object.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjkeysegment/bbjkeysegment_getfield.htm)

methods.name: getOffset
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns the zero-based offset of a [BBjKeySegment](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjkeysegment/bbjkeysegment.htm) object.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjkeysegment/bbjkeysegment_getoffset.htm)

methods.name: getLength
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns the length of a [BBjKeySegment](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjkeysegment/bbjkeysegment.htm) object.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjkeysegment/bbjkeysegment_getlength.htm)

methods.name: isDescending
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns whether a [BBjKeySegment](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjkeysegment/bbjkeysegment.htm) object is sorted in descending sequence.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjkeysegment/bbjkeysegment_isdescending.htm)

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns whether a [BBjKeySegment](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjkeysegment/bbjkeysegment.htm) object contains a Business Math value.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjkeysegment/bbjkeysegment_isnumeric.htm)

methods.name: isBUS
methods.docu: In BBj 10.00 and higher, this method returns whether a [BBjKeySegment](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjkeysegment/bbjkeysegment.htm) object contains a Business Math value[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjkeysegment/bbjkeysegment_isbus.htm)

methods.name: isOrderedNumeric
methods.docu: In BBj 10.00 and higher, this method returns whether a [BBjKeySegment](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjkeysegment/bbjkeysegment.htm) object contains an ordered numeric value[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjkeysegment/bbjkeysegment_isorderednumeric.htm)

classes.name: BBjRecoverFileStatus
classes.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, the BBjRecoverFileStatus
object is used to return various status information from file recovery.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjrecoverfilestatus/BBjRecoverFileStatus.htm)

methods.name: getRecoverStartTimeMillis
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method returns
the file recovery start time in milliseconds.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjrecoverfilestatus/BBjRecoverFileStatus_getRecoverStartTimeMillis.htm)

methods.name: getRecoverFinishTimeMillis
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method returns
the file recovery finish time in milliseconds.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjrecoverfilestatus/BBjRecoverFileStatus_getRecoverFinishTimeMillis.htm)

methods.name: getOriginalFileType
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method returns
the file recovery type.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjrecoverfilestatus/BBjRecoverFileStatus_getOriginalFileType.htm)

methods.name: getOriginalFilename
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this
method returns the file recovery filename. This is now the recovered file.
The original file has been backed up.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjrecoverfilestatus/BBjRecoverFileStatus_getOriginalFilename.htm)

methods.name: getRecoverBackupFilename
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this
method returns the file recovery file name for the recovered file backup.
This is the original file that was recovered, the recovered file is now
using the original file name.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjrecoverfilestatus/BBjRecoverFileStatus_getRecoverBackupFilename.htm)

methods.name: getOriginalRecordSize
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method returns the file recovery record
size from the original file. This is also the record size in the recovered
file.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjrecoverfilestatus/BBjRecoverFileStatus_getOriginalRecordSize.htm)

methods.name: getOriginalRecordCount
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method returns the file recovery original
record count.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjrecoverfilestatus/BBjRecoverFileStatus_getOriginalRecordCount.htm)

methods.name: getRecoveredRecordCount
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method returns the file recovery recovered
record count.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjrecoverfilestatus/BBjRecoverFileStatus_getRecoveredRecordCount.htm)

methods.name: getRecordsFound
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method returns the file recovery number
of records found in the original file.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjrecoverfilestatus/BBjRecoverFileStatus_getRecordsFound.htm)

methods.name: getOriginalSize
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method returns the file recovery original
file size.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjrecoverfilestatus/BBjRecoverFileStatus_getOriginalSize.htm)

methods.name: getRecoveredSize
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.00 and higher, this method returns the file recovery recovered
file size.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjrecoverfilestatus/BBjRecoverFileStatus_getRecoveredSize.htm)

classes.name: BBjClientFileSystem
classes.docu:
The BBjClientFileSystem object provides developers access to files on
the computer providing the display to the user.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfilesystem/bbjclientfilesystem.htm)

methods.name: clearCache
methods.docu: Clear the server-side cache.

methods.name: getClientFile
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns a [BBjClientFile](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile.htm)
that represents a specific file on the remote computer.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfilesystem/bbjclientfilesystem_getclientfile.htm)

methods.name: getClientFile
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns a [BBjClientFile](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile.htm)
that represents a specific file on the remote computer.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfilesystem/bbjclientfilesystem_getclientfile.htm)

methods.name: getHomeDirectory
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns a [BBjClientFile](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile.htm)
that represents the home directory of the user running BBj on the client
computer.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfilesystem/bbjclientfilesystem_gethomedirectory.htm)

methods.name: getRoots
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns a [BBjVector](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjvector/bbjvector.htm)
of [BBjClientFile](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile.htm) objects
that represent the filesystem roots on the client computer.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfilesystem/bbjclientfilesystem_getroots.htm)

classes.name: BBjAppletProxy
classes.docu: The BBjAppletProxy provides control of the Applet and AppletContext when a BBj program is being run through an Applet.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjappletproxy/bbjappletproxy.htm)

methods.name: setBounds
methods.docu: In BBj 2.02 and higher, this method sets the location and size of a running Applet.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjappletproxy/bbjappletproxy_setbounds.htm)

methods.name: getParam
methods.docu: In BBj 2.02 and higher, this method retrieves the value of a parameter that was set within the HTML from which the Applet was launched.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjappletproxy/bbjappletproxy_getparam.htm)

methods.name: showDocument
methods.docu: In BBj 2.02 and higher, this method displays the specified URL in a separate browser frame.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjappletproxy/bbjappletproxy_showdocument.htm)

methods.name: showStatus
methods.docu: In BBj 2.02 and higher, this method displays a message on the browser status bar.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjappletproxy/bbjappletproxy_showstatus.htm)

methods.name: playAudio
methods.docu: In BBj 2.02 and higher, this method displays a specified URL in a separate browser frame.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjappletproxy/bbjappletproxy_playaudio.htm)

methods.name: playAudio
methods.docu: In BBj 2.02 and higher, this method displays a specified URL in a separate browser frame.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjappletproxy/bbjappletproxy_playaudio.htm)

methods.name: addFrame
methods.docu: In BBj 2.02 and higher, this method displays a specified URL in a frame within the Applet.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjappletproxy/bbjappletproxy_addframe.htm)

methods.name: removeFrame
methods.docu: In BBj 2.02 and higher, this method removes a frame that has previously been created through a call to [`addFrame()`](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjappletproxy/bbjappletproxy_addframe.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjappletproxy/bbjappletproxy_removeframe.htm)

classes.name: BBjProgramInfo
classes.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, the BBjProgramInfo object provides
programmatic access to information about a program.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjprograminfo/bbjprograminfo.htm)

methods.name: getListing
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns the complete listing for the program referenced by a [BBjProgramInfo](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjprograminfo/bbjprograminfo.htm) object.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjprograminfo/bbjprograminfo_getlisting.htm)

methods.name: getListingVector
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns a [BBjVector](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjvector/bbjvector.htm) of strings containing the complete listing for a program referenced by a [BBjProgramInfo](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjprograminfo/bbjprograminfo.htm) object.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjprograminfo/bbjprograminfo_getlistingvector.htm)

methods.name: getListingForLine
methods.docu: In BBj 22.11 and higher, this method returns the listing for a specified user-defined or physical line of a program referenced by a [BBjProgramInfo](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjprograminfo/bbjprograminfo.htm) object.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjprograminfo/BBjProgramInfo_getListingForLine.htm)

methods.name: getListingForPhysicalLine
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns the listing for a specified physical line of a program referenced by a [BBjProgramInfo](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjprograminfo/bbjprograminfo.htm) object.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjprograminfo/bbjprograminfo_getlistingforphysicalline.htm)

methods.name: getLineCount
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns the number of lines in the program referenced by a [BBjProgramInfo](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjprograminfo/bbjprograminfo.htm) object.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjprograminfo/bbjprograminfo_getlinecount.htm)

methods.name: hasLineNumbers
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns whether the program referenced by a [BBjProgramInfo](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjprograminfo/bbjprograminfo.htm) object has line numbers.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjprograminfo/bbjprograminfo_haslinenumbers.htm)

methods.name: getCanonicalProgramName
methods.docu: In BBj 25.12 and higher, this method returns the canonical program name for the program referenced by a [BBjProgramInfo](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjprograminfo/bbjprograminfo.htm) object.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjprograminfo/bbjprograminfo_getCanonicalProgramName.htm)

classes.name: BBjMsgBox
classes.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, the BBjMsgBox object is equivalent to the [MSGBOX() Function](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/commands/bbj-commands/msgbox_function_bbj.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjMsgBox/BBjMsgBox.htm)

methods.name: button1
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method sets custom text or HTML for the first button of this [BBjMsgBox](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjMsgBox/BBjMsgBox.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjMsgBox/BBjMsgBox_button1.htm)

methods.name: button2
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method sets custom text or HTML for the second button of this [BBjMsgBox](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjMsgBox/BBjMsgBox.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjMsgBox/BBjMsgBox_button2.htm)

methods.name: button3
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method sets custom text or HTML for the third button of this [BBjMsgBox](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjMsgBox/BBjMsgBox.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjMsgBox/BBjMsgBox_button3.htm)

methods.name: message
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method sets the message text or HTML for this [BBjMsgBox](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjMsgBox/BBjMsgBox.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjMsgBox/BBjMsgBox_message.htm)

methods.name: modes
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method sets assorted options on this [BBjMsgBox](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjMsgBox/BBjMsgBox.htm), corresponding to the MODE= option of the [ MSGBOX() Function](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/commands/bbj-commands/msgbox_function_bbj.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjMsgBox/BBjMsgBox_modes.htm)

methods.name: options
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method sets assorted options on this [BBjMsgBox](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjMsgBox/BBjMsgBox.htm), corresponding to the int **expr** parameter of the [MSGBOX() Function](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/commands/bbj-commands/msgbox_function_bbj.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjMsgBox/BBjMsgBox_options.htm)

methods.name: show
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method shows the [BBjMsgBox](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjMsgBox/BBjMsgBox.htm) dialog and waits for the user to make a selection.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjMsgBox/BBjMsgBox_show.htm)

methods.name: timeout
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method sets the [BBjMsgBox](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjMsgBox/BBjMsgBox.htm) timeout in seconds. If not specified, the BBjMsgBox will wait indefinitely for the user to make a selection.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjMsgBox/BBjMsgBox_timeout.htm)

methods.name: title
methods.docu: In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method sets the title text for this [BBjMsgBox](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjMsgBox/BBjMsgBox.htm) dialog.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjMsgBox/BBjMsgBox_title.htm)

classes.name: BBjPrintPreviewBuilder
classes.docu: In BBj 13.0 and higher, the BBjPrintPreviewBuilder object provides methods for configuring print preview, for example setting the initial view to two pages.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjprintpreviewbuilder/BBjPrintPreviewBuilder.html)

methods.name: closeOnPrint
methods.docu: In BBj 13.0 and higher, this method overrides the default and keeps preview open. The print preview default is to exit after printing.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjprintpreviewbuilder/BBjPrintPreviewBuilder_closeOnPrint.html)

methods.name: editPassword
methods.docu: In BBj 13.0 and higher, this method sets the editor password, allowing modification of any document saved as a PDF.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjprintpreviewbuilder/BBjPrintPreviewBuilder_editPassword.html)

methods.name: maximize
methods.docu: In BBj 13.0 and higher, this method maximizes the Print Preview window after opening.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjprintpreviewbuilder/BBjPrintPreviewBuilder_maximize.html)

methods.name: openPassword
methods.docu: In BBj 13.0 and higher, this method sets the open password that required to open any document saved as a PDF.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjprintpreviewbuilder/BBjPrintPreviewBuilder_openPassword.html)

methods.name: preview
methods.docu: In BBj 13.0 and higher, this method opens a preview window once configuration is complete.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjprintpreviewbuilder/BBjPrintPreviewBuilder_preview.html)

methods.name: secure
methods.docu: In BBj 13.0 and higher, this method sets secure(0) to override the default, removing all document security. This is useful after saving a PDF as the file is not editable by default.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjprintpreviewbuilder/BBjPrintPreviewBuilder_secure.html)

methods.name: style
methods.docu: In BBj 13.0 and higher, this method controls the view style. "HEIGHT" fits a page vertically in the available space, "WIDTH" horizontally in the available space, "TWO" displays two pages side-by-side.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjprintpreviewbuilder/BBjPrintPreviewBuilder_style.html)

methods.name: zoom
methods.docu: In BBj 13.00 and higher, this method scales the document to take up more or less space in the preview window; zoom 50 is half size, zoom 200 is double size.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjprintpreviewbuilder/bbjprintpreviewbuilder_zoom.html)

classes.name: BBjApplication
classes.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, the BBjApplication object
represents a published BUI application and is immutable. Changes are made through
the [BBjAppConfig](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/bbjappconfig.htm) object.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/bbjapplication.htm)

methods.name: getApplicationIcon
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns a [BBjResourceUrl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjresourceurl/BBjResourceUrl.html) corresponding to the application's icon.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_getApplicationIcon.html)

methods.name: getApplicationUserName
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the application user name, which corresponds to the BBj `-n` parameter.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_getApplicationUserName.html)

methods.name: getBBjApplicationName
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the application name, which corresponds to the BBj -a parameter.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_getBBjApplicationName.html)

methods.name: getClasspathName

methods.name: closeAll
methods.docu:
attempt to close the MDI Window and all MDI clients within a specified
timeout period. Any client that has registered an MDIClosing
callback will be polled. If any client vetoes the close then this
method immediately returns. If all clients either RELEASE their
Interpreter or else call approveMDIClose() within the specified
timeout then method will terminate the RuntimeMgr. If the timeout
expires before all MDICloseListeners are polled then this method
throws BBjException.IO_ERR

**Parameters:**

- `p_timeoutInSeconds` if zero, wait forever.

**Returns:** boolean returns zero if someone vetoed

methods.name: closeAllClients
