classes.name: BBjCookie
classes.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, BBjCookie
creates
a cookie, a small amount of information sent by a servlet to a Web browser,
saved by the browser, and later sent back to the server. A cookie's value
can uniquely identify a client, so cookies are commonly used for session
management.

A
cookie has a name, a single value, and optional attributes such as a comment,
path and domain qualifiers, a maximum age, and a version number. Some
Web browsers have bugs in how they handle the optional attributes, so
use them sparingly to improve the interoperability of your servlets.

The
servlet sends cookies to the browser which adds fields to HTTP response
headers to send cookies to the browser, one at a time. The browser is
expected to support 20 cookies for each Web server, 300 cookies total,
and may limit cookie size to 4 KB each.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/bbjcookie.htm)

methods.name: getComment
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the comment from the current
BBjCookie object.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/BBjCookie_getComment.htm)

methods.name: getDomain
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the domain within which
this cookie should be presented. The form of the domain name is specified
by RFC 2109. A domain name begins with a dot (.foo.com) and means that
the cookie is visible to servers in a specified Domain Name System (DNS)
zone (for example, www.foo.com, but not a.b.foo.com). By default, cookies
are only returned to the server that sent them.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/BBjCookie_getDomain.htm)

methods.name: getMaxAge
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the maximum age of the cookie,
specified in seconds, By default, -1 indicating the cookie will persist
until browser shutdown.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/BBjCookie_getMaxAge.htm)

methods.name: getName
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the name of the cookie.
The name cannot be changed after creation.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/BBjCookie_getName.htm)

methods.name: getPath
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the path on the server to
which the browser returns this [BBjCookie](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/bbjcookie.htm).
The cookie is visible to all subpaths on the server.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/BBjCookie_getPath.htm)

methods.name: getSecure
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns
true if the browser is sending cookies only over a secure protocol, or
false if the browser can send cookies using any protocol.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/bbjcookie_getsecure.htm)

methods.name: getValue
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the value from the current
[BBjCookie](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/bbjcookie.htm) object.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/BBjCookie_getValue.htm)

methods.name: getVersion
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the version of the protocol
this cookie complies with. Version 1 complies with RFC 2109, and version
0 complies with the original cookie specification drafted by Netscape.
Cookies provided by a browser use and identify the browser's cookie version.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/BBjCookie_getVersion.htm)

methods.name: setComment
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method sets a comment that describes a
cookie's purpose. The comment is useful if the browser presents the cookie
to the user. Comments are not supported by Netscape Version 0 cookies.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/BBjCookie_setComment.htm)

methods.name: setDomain
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method sets the domain within which this
cookie should be presented.

The form of the domain name is specified by RFC 2109. A domain name
begins with a dot (.foo.com) and means that the cookie is visible to servers
in a specified Domain Name System (DNS) zone (for example, www.foo.com,
but not a.b.foo.com). By default, cookies are only returned to the server
that sent them.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/BBjCookie_setDomain.htm)

methods.name: setMaxAge
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method sets the maximum age of the cookie
in seconds.

A positive value indicates that the cookie will expire after that many
seconds have passed. Note that the value is the maximum age when the cookie
will expire, not the cookie's current age.

A negative value means that the cookie is not stored persistently and
will be deleted when the Web browser exits. A zero value causes the cookie
to be deleted.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/BBjCookie_setMaxAge.htm)

methods.name: setPath
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method sets the path for the cookie to
which the client should return the [BBjCookie](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/bbjcookie.htm).

The cookie is visible to all the pages in the directory you specify,
and all the pages in that directory's sub-directories. A cookie's path
must include the servlet that set the cookie, for example, /catalog, which
makes the cookie visible to all directories on the server under /catalog.

Consult RFC 2109 (available on the Internet) for more information on
setting path names for cookies.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/BBjCookie_setPath.htm)

methods.name: setSecure
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method indicates to the browser whether
the cookie should only be sent using a secure protocol, such as HTTPS
or SSL.

The default value is false.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/BBjCookie_setSecure.htm)

methods.name: setValue
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method sets a new value to a cookie after
the cookie is created. If you use a binary value, you may want to use
BASE64 encoding. *

With Version 0 cookies, values should not contain white space, brackets,
parentheses, equals signs, commas, double quotes, slashes, question marks,
at signs, colons, and semicolons. Empty values may not behave the same
way on all browsers.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/BBjCookie_setValue.htm)

methods.name: setVersion
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method sets the version of the cookie protocol
this [BBjCookie](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/bbjcookie.htm) complies with.
Version 0 complies with the original Netscape cookie specification. Version
1 complies with RFC 2109.

Since RFC 2109 is still somewhat new, consider version 1 as experimental;
do not use it yet on production sites.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/BBjCookie_setVersion.htm)

methods.name: setHttpOnly
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.04 and higher, this method indicates
that the cookie should only be sent over HTTP. It can be used to prevent
client-side scripts from accessing the cookie.

The default value is false.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/bbjcookie_sethttponly.htm)

methods.name: isHttpOnly
methods.docu:

true if the cookie can only be sent over HTTP.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/bbjcookie_ishttponly.htm)

In BBj 10.00 and higher, this method returns a group identifier for the
session group to which this BBjSession belongs. A group identifier is
an integer value shared by an original BBj session and any child sessions
started via SCALL, BACKGROUND, and [newBBjSession](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjapi/bbjapi_newbbjsession.htm).

the group identifier used by [BBjAPI::getGroupNamespace](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjapi/bbjapi_getgroupnamespace.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjsessioninfo/bbjsessioninfo_getgroupid.htm)

methods.name: getSessionID
methods.docu:
In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method returns a unique identifier for the
session described by this [BBjSessionInfo](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjsessioninfo/bbjsessioninfo.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjsessioninfo/bbjsessioninfo_getsessionid.htm)

methods.name: getMessage

methods.name: getCpuTime

In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns a boolean indicating whether

In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns a boolean indicating whether

methods.name: encodeRedirectURL
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method encodes the specified URL for use
in the [BBjHttpResponse::sendRedirect(String)](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_sendRedirect.htm)
method or, if encoding is not needed, returns the URL unchanged. The implementation
of this method includes the logic to determine whether the session ID
needs to be encoded in the URL. Because the rules for making this determination
can differ from those used to decide whether to encode a normal link,
this method is separated from the encodeURL method.

All URLs sent to the [BBjHttpResponse::sendRedirect(String)](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_sendRedirect.htm)
method should be run through this method. Otherwise, URL rewriting cannot
be used with browsers which do not support cookies.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_encodeRedirectURL.htm)

methods.name: encodeURL
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method encodes the specified URL by including
the session ID in it, or, if encoding is not needed, returns the URL unchanged.
The implementation of this method includes the logic to determine whether
the session ID needs to be encoded in the URL. For example, if the browser
supports cookies, or session tracking is turned off, URL encoding is unnecessary.

For robust session tracking, all URLs emitted by a servlet should be
run through this method. Otherwise, URL rewriting cannot be used with
browsers which do not support cookies.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_encodeURL.htm)

methods.name: getCharacterEncoding
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the name of the character
encoding (MIME charset) used for the body sent in this response. The character
encoding may have been specified explicitly using the [BBjHttpResponse::setCharacterEncoding(String)](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_setCharacterEncoding.htm)
or [BBjHttpResponse::setContentType(String)](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_setContentType.htm)
methods, or implicitly using the [BBjHttpResponse::setLocale(Locale)](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_setLocale.htm)
method. Explicit specifications take precedence over implicit specifications.
Calls made to these methods after the response has been committed have
no effect on the character encoding. If no character encoding has been
specified, ISO-8859-1 is returned.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_getCharacterEncoding.htm)

methods.name: getContentType
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the content type used for
the MIME body sent in this response. The content type must have been specified
using [BBjHttpResponse::setContentType(String)](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_setContentType.htm)
before the response is committed. If no content type has been specified,
this method returns null(). If a content type has been specified, and
a character encoding has been explicitly or implicitly specified, the
charset is included in the string returned. If no character encoding has
been specified, the charset is omitted.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_getContentType.htm)

methods.name: getHeader
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the value of the response
header with the given name.

If a response header with the given name exists and contains multiple
values, the value that was added first will be returned.

This method considers only response headers set or added via [BBjHttpResponse::setHeader(String,
String)](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_setHeader.htm) or [BBjHttpResponse::addHeader(String,
String)](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_addHeader.htm), respectively.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_getHeader.htm)

methods.name: getHeaderNames
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns a [BBjVector](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjvector/bbjvector.htm)
containing the names of the headers of this response.

This method considers only response headers set or added via [BBjHttpResponse::setHeader(String,
String)](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_setHeader.htm), [BBjHttpResponse::addHeader(java.lang.String,
java.lang.String)](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_addHeader.htm), respectively.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_getHeaderNames.htm)

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns a [BBjVector](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjvector/bbjvector.htm)
containing all the values of the specified header from the [BBjHttpResponse](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/bbjhttpresponse.htm)
object.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_getHeaders.htm)

methods.name: getLocale
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the [Locale](https://docs.oracle.com/javase/8/docs/api/java/util/Locale.html)
specified for this [BBjHttpResponse](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/bbjhttpresponse.htm)
using the setLocale(java.util.Locale) method. Calls made to [BBjHttpResponse::setLocale(Locale)](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_setLocale.htm)
after the response is committed have no effect. If no locale has been
specified, the container's default locale is returned.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_getLocale.htm)

methods.name: getStatus

methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method sends an error response to the client
using the specified status.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_sendError.htm)

methods.name: sendRedirect
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method sends a redirect to the client.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_sendRedirect.htm)

methods.name: setCharacterEncoding
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method sets the character encoding for
the [BBjHttpResponse](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/bbjhttpresponse.htm) object.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_setCharacterEncoding.htm)

methods.name: setContentType
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method sets the MIME type for the [BBjHttpResponse](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/bbjhttpresponse.htm)
object.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_setContentType.htm)

methods.name: setHeader
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method sets a response header with the
given name and value. If the header had already been set, the new value
overwrites the previous one. The containsHeader method can be used to
test for the presence of a header before setting its value.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_setHeader.htm)

methods.name: setLocale
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method sets the locale of the response.
It also sets the response's character encoding appropriately for the locale,
if the character encoding has not been explicitly set using [BBjHttpResponse::setContentType(String)](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_setContentType.htm)
or [BBjHttpResponse::setCharacterEncoding(String)](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_setCharacterEncoding.htm).

This method may be called repeatedly to change locale and character
encoding. It does not set the response's character encoding if it is called
after [BBjHttpResponse::setContentType(String)](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_setContentType.htm)
has been called with a charset specification or after [BBjHttpResponse::setCharacterEncoding(String)](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_setCharacterEncoding.htm)
has been called.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_setLocale.htm)

methods.name: setStatus
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method sets the status code for the [BBjHttpResponse](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/bbjhttpresponse.htm) object.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_setStatus.htm)

methods.name: setFile
methods.docu: In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method sets a file for download.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_setFile.htm)

classes.name: BBjHttpRequest
classes.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, BBjHttpRequest object
provides methods for querying the state of an HTTP request.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest.htm)

methods.name: getCharacterEncoding
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the character encoding used
by the client to create this [BBjHttpRequest](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getCharacterEncoding.htm)

methods.name: getContentLength
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the size in bytes of the
body in this [BBjHttpRequest](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getContentLength.htm)

methods.name: getContentType
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the MIME type of the body
in this [BBjHttpRequest](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest.htm)[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getContentType.htm)

methods.name: getCookies
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the a [BBjVector](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjvector/bbjvector.htm)
containing all the [BBjCookie](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/bbjcookie.htm)
objects from the [BBjHttpRequest](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest.htm)
object.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getCookies.htm)

methods.name: getHeader
getHeaderNames
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the a [BBjVector](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjvector/bbjvector.htm)
containing all the header names from the [BBjHttpRequest](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest.htm)
object.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getHeaderNames.htm)

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns
the a [BBjVector](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjvector/bbjvector.htm) containing
all the values for the specified header in the [BBjHttpRequest](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest.htm)
object.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest_getheaders.htm)

methods.name: getLocalAddr
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the Internet protocol (IP)
address of the interface on which the [BBjHttpRequest](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest.htm)
was received.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getLocalAddr.htm)

methods.name: getLocale
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the preferred [Locale](https://docs.oracle.com/javase/8/docs/api/java/util/Locale.html)
that the client will accept content in, based on the Accept-Language header.
If the client request doesn't provide an Accept-Language header, this
method returns the default locale for the server.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getLocale.htm)

methods.name: getLocales
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the a [BBjVector](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjvector/bbjvector.htm)
containing [Locale](https://docs.oracle.com/javase/8/docs/api/java/util/Locale.html)
objects indicating, in decreasing order starting with the preferred locale,
the locales that are acceptable to the client based on the Accept-Language
header. If the client request doesn't provide an Accept-Language header,
this method returns an Enumeration containing one Locale, the default
locale for the server.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getLocales.htm)

methods.name: getLocalName
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the host name of the Internet
protocol (IP) interface on which the [BBjHttpRequest](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest.htm)
was received.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getLocalName.htm)

methods.name: getLocalPort
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the Internet protocol (IP)
port number of the interface on which the [BBjHttpRequest](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest.htm)
was received.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getLocalPort.htm)

methods.name: getMethod
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this
method returns the name of the HTTP method with which this request was
made.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest_getmethod.htm)

methods.name: getParameter
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the value of the named request
parameter as a string.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getParameter.htm)

methods.name: getParameterNames
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns a BBjVector, containing the
names of all the parameters passed in by this request.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getParameterNames.htm)

methods.name: getParameterValues
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns all of the parameter values
associated with this parameter name.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getParameterValues.htm)

methods.name: getPathInfo
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns any extra path information
associated with the URL the client sent when it made this [BBjHttpRequest](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getPathInfo.htm)

methods.name: getProtocol
getQueryString
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns
the
query string that is contained in the request URL after the path.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getQueryString.htm)

methods.name: getRemoteAddr
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the Internet protocol (IP)
address of the client or last proxy that sent the [BBjHttpRequest](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getRemoteAddr.htm)

methods.name: getRemoteHost
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the fully qualified name
of the client or the last proxy that sent the request. If the engine cannot
or chooses not to resolve the hostname (to improve performance), this
method returns the dotted-string form of the IP address.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getRemoteHost.htm)

methods.name: getRemotePort
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the port number to which
the request was sent.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getRemotePort.htm)

methods.name: getRemoteUser
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the login of the user making
this request, if the user has been authenticated, or null() if the user
has not been authenticated.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getRemoteUser.htm)

methods.name: getRequestedSessionId
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the session ID specified
by the client.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getRequestedSessionId.htm)

methods.name: getRequestURI
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the part of this request's
URL from the protocol name up to the query string in the first line of
the [BBjHttpRequest](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getRequestURI.htm)

methods.name: getRequestURL
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the URL the client used
in the [BBjHttpRequest](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getRequestURL.htm)

methods.name: getScheme
getServerName
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the host-name of the server
to which the request was sent. It is the value of the part before ":"
in the Host header value, if any, or the resolved server name, or the
server IP address.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getServerName.htm)

methods.name: getServerPort
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the port number to which
the request was sent. It is the value of the part after ":"
in the Host header value, if any, or the server port upon which the client
connection was accepted.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getServerPort.htm)

methods.name: getServletPath
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the part of this request's
URL that calls the servlet.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getServletPath.htm)

methods.name: getSession
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the [BBjHttpSession](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpsession/bbjhttpsession.htm)
associated with the [BBjHttpRequest](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getSession.htm)

methods.name: isRequestedSessionIdFromCookie
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method checks whether the requested session
ID came in as a cookie.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_isRequestedSessionIdFromCookie.htm)

methods.name: isRequestedSessionIdFromURL
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method checks whether the requested session
ID came in as part of the request URL.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_isRequestedSessionIdFromURL.htm)

methods.name: isRequestedSessionIdValid
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method checks whether the requested session
ID is still valid.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_isRequestedSessionIdValid.htm)

methods.name: isSecure
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns a boolean indicating whether
this request was made using a secure channel, such as HTTPS.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_isSecure.htm)

methods.name: getFileUploads
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns
a [BBjVector](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjvector/bbjvector.htm) of [BBjFileUpload](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjfileupload/BBjFileUpload.htm)
objects that have been posted and available in a [BBjHttpRequest](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest.htm)
object.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getFileUploads.htm)

methods.name: getFileUpload
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns
a [BBjFileUpload](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjfileupload/BBjFileUpload.htm) object
available in a [BBjHttpRequest](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest.htm)
object.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getFileUpload.htm)

methods.name: getBody
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this
method returns a [BBjString](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString.htm)
object which contains the body of a POSTed request to a servlet.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getBody.htm)

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method returns
the value of the named attribute as an Object, or null() if no attribute
of the given name exists.

Attributes can be set using [BBjHttpRequest::setAttribute()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest_setattribute.htm).
This allows information to be embedded into a request before a RequestDispatcher
call.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest_getattribute.htm)

methods.name: getAttributeNames
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method returns
a BBjVector containing the names of the attributes available to this request.
This method returns an empty BBjVector if the request has no attributes
available to it.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest_getattributenames.htm)

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method removes
an attribute from this request. This method is not generally needed as
attributes only persist as long as the request is being handled.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest_removeattribute.htm)

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method stores
an attribute in this request. Attributes are reset between requests. This
method is most often used in conjunction with [BBjHttpResponse::sendRedirect](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_sendRedirect.htm).

Attribute names should follow the same conventions
as package names. If the object passed in is null(), the effect is the
same as calling [BBjHttpRequest::removeAttribute(String)](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest_removeattribute.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest_setattribute.htm)

classes.name: BBjBuiAppCloseAction
classes.docu: In BBj 14.00 and higher, the BBjBuiAppCloseAction object provides an interface to chain to another BUI or DWC application on termination of a BUI or DWC application.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiAppCloseAction/BBjBuiAppCloseAction.htm)

methods.name: getActionType
methods.docu: In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns an integer constant identifying the type of this close action (ACTION_APP).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiAppCloseAction/BBjBuiAppCloseAction_getActionType.htm)

methods.name: getActionTypeString
methods.docu: In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns a string constant identifying the type of this close action (ACTION_APP).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiAppCloseAction/BBjBuiAppCloseAction_getActionTypeString.htm)

methods.name: getAppName
methods.docu: In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns the BUI or DWC application name to be run from this close action.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiAppCloseAction/bbjbuiappcloseaction_getappname.htm)

classes.name: BBjBuiCloseAction
classes.docu: In BBj 14.00 and higher, the BBjBuiCloseAction object provides an interface to configure the termination actions of a BUI or DWC application.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiCloseAction/bbjbuicloseaction.htm)

methods.name: getActionTypeString
methods.docu: In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns a string constant identifying the type of this close action.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiCloseAction/BBjBuiCloseAction_getActionTypeString.htm)

methods.name: getActionType
methods.docu: In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns an integer constant identifying the type of this close action.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiCloseAction/bbjbuicloseAction_getactiontype.htm)

classes.name: BBjAppConfig
classes.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, a BBjAppConfig object is used to configure a
BUI [BBjApplication](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/bbjapplication.htm) in preparation for
publishing it to the [BBjAppServer](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver.html).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/bbjappconfig.htm)

methods.name: buildApplication
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns a [BBjApplication](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/bbjapplication.htm) object with the values specified in this [BBjAppConfig](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/bbjappconfig.htm). This next step would normally be to publish the BBjApplication to the BBjAppServer.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_buildApplication.html)

methods.name: clearClientPollInterval
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method clears any application-specific setting and uses the server's default setting for the length of time in seconds the web server will wait for the next command from BBjServices.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_clearClientPollInterval.html)

methods.name: clearDevelopmentMode
methods.docu:
In BBj 16.00
and higher, this method clears any application-specific development mode
setting and uses the server's default setting.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_clearDevelopmentMode.htm)

methods.name: clearDisallowConsole
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.10 and higher, this method
clears any application-specific setting for whether console access should
be disallowed for this application, and uses the server's default setting
instead.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_clearDisallowConsole.htm)

methods.name: clearEndAction
methods.docu: In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method clears any application-specific setting and uses the server's default application termination action.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_clearEndAction.html)

methods.name: clearErrAction
methods.docu: In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method clears any application-specific setting and uses the server's default application error termination action.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_clearErrAction.html)

methods.name: clearManageBrowserHistory
methods.docu:
In BBj 16.00
and higher, this method clears any application-specific setting for managing
browser history and uses the server's default setting.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_clearManageBrowserHistory.htm)

methods.name: clearOmitBasisCss
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method clears any application-specific
setting and uses the server's default OmitBasisCss setting.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_clearOmitBasisCss.htm)

methods.name: clearSecure
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.10 and higher, this method clears any application-specific
setting and uses the server's default setting for whether this application
should be started in secure mode.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_clearSecure.htm)

methods.name: clearSessionTimeout
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method clears any application-specific setting and uses the server's default setting for the length of time in seconds a BUI session will be considered active.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_clearSessionTimeout.html)

methods.name: clearShowBrowserWarning
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method clears any application-specific setting and uses the server's default setting for whether to show a browser warning the first time the user attempts to run a BUI application in Internet Explorer 8.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_clearShowBrowserWarning.html)

methods.name: clearShowClientConfirmationDialog

classes.name: BBjClientFile
classes.docu:
The BBjClientFile object provides developers methods to manipulate a
specific client-side file.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile.htm)

methods.name: canExecute
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.0 and higher, this [BBjClientFile](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile.htm)
method returns whether the client file is executable.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile_canexecute.htm)

methods.name: canRead
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.0 and higher, this [BBjClientFile](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile.htm)
method returns whether the client file can be read.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile_canread.htm)

methods.name: canWrite
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.0 and higher, this method returns whether the file exists and
whether BBj has write access to the file.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile_canwrite.htm)

methods.name: copyFromClient
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.0 and higher, this method copies the file this [BBjClientFile](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile.htm)
represents to the server and returns the name of the file to which it
was copied.

In BBj 14.0 and higher, a server directory or fully-qualified server filename may be specified.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile_copyfromclient.htm)

methods.name: copyFromClient
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.0 and higher, this method copies the file this [BBjClientFile](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile.htm)
represents to the server and returns the name of the file to which it
was copied.

In BBj 14.0 and higher, a server directory or fully-qualified server filename may be specified.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile_copyfromclient.htm)

methods.name: copyToClient
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.0 and higher, this method copies the specified file from the
server to the client. The [BBjClientFile](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile.htm)
represents the file on the client to which it will be copied.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile_copytoclient.htm)

methods.name: createNewFile
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.0 and higher, this method will create the file represented
by this [BBjClientFile](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile_createnewfile.htm)

methods.name: delete
methods.docu: In BBj 7.0 and higher, this method deletes the file the [BBjClientFile](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile_delete.htm)

methods.name: exists
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.0 and higher, this method returns whether the file this [BBjClientFile](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile.htm) represents
exists.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile_exists.htm)

methods.name: getCanonicalFile
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.0 and higher, this method returns a [BBjClientFile](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile.htm)
that represents the "canonical" file represented by this BBjClientFile.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile_getcanonicalfile.htm)

methods.name: getContents
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.0 and higher, this method returns the contents of the file
this [BBjClientFile](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile.htm) represents.
If the file does not
exist, it reports [!ERROR=12](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/usr/Errors/_error_12.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile_getcontents.htm)

methods.name: getName
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.0 and higher, this method returns the last path component in
a file name (the simple file name).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile_getname.htm)

methods.name: getParent
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.0 and higher, this method returns a [BBjClientFile](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile.htm)
that represents the directory containing this BBjClientFile.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile_getparent.htm)

methods.name: getPath
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.0 and higher, this method returns the absolute path of the
file.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile_getpath.htm)

methods.name: isDirectory
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.0 and higher, this method returns whether this [BBjClientFile](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile.htm)
represents a directory.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile_isdirectory.htm)

methods.name: isFile
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.0 and higher, this method returns whether this [BBjClientFile](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile.htm)
represents a normal file.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile_isfile.htm)

methods.name: isHidden
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.0 and higher, this [BBjClientFile](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile.htm)
method returns whether this file is considered hidden by the operating
system.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile_ishidden.htm)

methods.name: lastModified
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.0 and higher, this [BBjClientFile](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile.htm)
method returns the time at which this file was last modified in milliseconds.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile_lastmodified.htm)

methods.name: listFiles
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.0 and higher, this [BBjClientFile](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile.htm)
method returns a vector containing the list of the files in a directory.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile_listfiles.htm)

methods.name: mkdir
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.0 and higher, this [BBjClientFile](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile.htm)
method creates a directory named by this [BBjClientFile](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile_mkdir.htm)

methods.name: mkdirs
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.0 and higher, this method creates a directory at the path named
by this [BBjClientFile](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile_mkdirs.htm)

methods.name: renameTo
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.0 and higher, this method renames the file represented by this
[BBjClientFile](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile.htm) to the specified
value.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfile/bbjclientfile_renameto.htm)

methods.name: setContents

methods.name: getProcess
methods.docu:
This is a dangerous method. It allows one to get the BBjProcess
that's currently running. The point of this is to be able to debug
problems by inspecting objects in the current process. BBjProcess
has the root of almost all the objects used in a running session, so
we return it from this method.

methods.name: userTypes
methods.docu:
user interaction commands here is a sample

LET myAPI!=BBjAPI()
SYSGUI=UNT
OPEN (SYSGUI) "X0"
LET mySysGui!=myAPI!.getSysGui()
myWindow! = mySysGui!.addWindow(10,10,200,300,"interaction sample")
myButton! = myWindow!.addButton(101,10,10,90,30,"STOP",$0800$)
myButton!.setCallback(myButton!.ON_BUTTON_PUSH,"STOP_BUTTON_PUSHED")
myButton2! = myWindow!.addButton(102,10,50,90,30,"START",$0800$)
myButton2!.setCallback(myButton2!.ON_BUTTON_PUSH,"START_BUTTON_PUSHED")
myButton3! = myWindow!.addButton(103,10,90,90,30,"RUN",$0800$)
myButton3!.setCallback(myButton3!.ON_BUTTON_PUSH,"RUN_BUTTON_PUSHED")
myButton4! = myWindow!.addButton(104,10,130,90,30,"STUFF",$0800$)
myButton4!.setCallback(myButton4!.ON_BUTTON_PUSH,"STUFF_BUTTON_PUSHED")

myCEdit! = myWindow!.addCEdit(110,50,200,90,30,"",$0008$)
myWindow!.setCallback(myWindow!.ON_CLOSE,"APP_CLOSE")
t! = bbjapi().getTest()
PROCESS_EVENTS
START_BUTTON_PUSHED:
t!.startMacro()
RETURN
STOP_BUTTON_PUSHED:
mac$ = t!.endMacro()
print mac$
RETURN
RUN_BUTTON_PUSHED:
execute mac$
RETURN
STUFF_BUTTON_PUSHED:
t!.mouseClick(myCedit!)
t!.userTypes("hello")
RETURN
APP_CLOSE:
RELEASE
RETURN

methods.name: testPublicAPIs
methods.docu:
This method goes through the Primitives declared in TypeResolver and
makes sure none of the interfaces extends interfaces that are not in
com.basis.bbj.* and NOT in com.basis.bbj.proxies.internal

This comes about because a great many of the interfaces extend AutoWrappable
Which causes the methods of AutoWrappable to be exposed to the user.

methods.name: dieAfter
methods.docu:
Use to kill the current process after a certain amount of time. p_ms is
the number of milliseconds it should wait, and p_status is the exit code
it should use.

**Parameters:**

- `p_ms` Milliseconds to wait
- `p_status` exit code to use, use one of `#OK`, `#FAIL`,
`#SKIP`, or `#ERROR`.

External CSS is injected asynchronously; success or failure is reported with [BBjLinkLoadedEvent](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjevents/BBjLinkLoadedEvent/BBjLinkLoadedEvent.htm) or [BBjLinkFailedEvent](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjevents/BBjLinkFailedEvent/BBjLinkFailedEvent.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiManager/BBjBuiManager_injectStyleUrl.htm)

methods.docu: In BBj 22.03 and higher, this method sets a DWC [theme](https://dwc.style/docs/#/dwc/guide/themes), or sets the theme to "system" to use the system default theme.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiManager/BBjWebManager_setTheme.htm)

methods.name: getTheme
methods.docu: In BBj 22.03 and higher, this method returns the name of the current DWC theme.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiManager/BBjWebManager_getTheme.htm)

methods.name: setDarkTheme
methods.docu: In BBj 22.03 and higher, this method sets the name of the [theme](https://dwc.style/docs/#/dwc/guide/themes) to use when a DWC application has specified the system theme option with setTheme("system") and the user has configured their system to use dark mode. This will usually be "dark", but the "dark-pure" variant is also available.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiManager/BBjWebManager_setDarkTheme.htm)

methods.name: getDarkTheme
methods.docu: In BBj 22.03 and higher, this method returns the name of the [theme](https://dwc.style/docs/#/dwc/guide/themes) to use when a DWC application has specified the system theme option with setTheme("system") and the user has configured their system to use dark mode.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiManager/BBjWebManager_getDarkTheme.htm)

methods.name: setLightTheme
methods.docu: In BBj 22.03 and higher, this method sets the name of the [theme](https://dwc.style/docs/#/dwc/guide/themes) to use when a DWC application has specified the system theme option with setTheme("system") and the user has configured their system to use light mode. This will usually be "light".[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiManager/BBjWebManager_setLightTheme.htm)

methods.name: getLightTheme
methods.docu: In BBj 22.03 and higher, this method returns the name of the [theme](https://dwc.style/docs/#/dwc/guide/themes) to use when a DWC application has specified the system theme option with setTheme("system") and the user has configured their system to use light mode.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiManager/BBjWebManager_getLightTheme.htm)

classes.name: BBjAppServer
classes.docu:
In BBj 10.00 and higher, the BBjAppServer is used to manage the BUI Application
Server; starting and stopping the server, publishing BUI applications,
and managing server resources and global configuration settings.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver.html)

methods.name: addApplicationIcon
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method adds the contents of the file represented by `iconFileName` to the set of static resources in the [BBjAppServer](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver.html).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver_addapplicationicon.html)

methods.name: addStaticResource
methods.docu:
**In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method adds
the contents of the file represented byfileNameto
the set of static resources in the** [BBjAppServer](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver.html). **If the MIME typemimeTypeis
not specified, an automatically detected MIME type is used.**[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver_addstaticresource.html)

methods.name: addStaticResource
methods.docu:
**In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method adds
the contents of the file represented byfileNameto
the set of static resources in the** [BBjAppServer](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver.html). **If the MIME typemimeTypeis
not specified, an automatically detected MIME type is used.**[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver_addstaticresource.html)

methods.name: addStyleSheet
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, adds the contents of the file represented by `styleSheetFileName`, with the MIME type `text/css`, to the static resources in the [BBjAppServer](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver.html). This is equivalent to calling `[addStaticResource(styleSheetFileName, "text/css")](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver_addstaticresource.html)`.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver_addstylesheet.html)

methods.name: getAllAppNames
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, returns the names of all applications published[BBjAppServer](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver.html).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver_getallappnames.html)

methods.name: getApplication
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, returns a published application with the given name. If no application exists with the given name, this method will throw an exception.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver_getapplication.html)

methods.name: getClientPollInterval
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, this is the length of time in seconds the web server will wait for the next command from BBjServices. The default value is 50 seconds. If the web server does not receive a command from BBjServices in the configured time period, it will send a heartbeat to the browser.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver_getclientpollinterval.html)

methods.name: getDevelopmentMode
methods.docu: In BBj 16.00 and higher,this method returns a boolean indicating whether to run BUI apps in development mode. The default value is `false`.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/BBjAppServer_getDevelopmentMode.htm)

methods.name: getDisallowConsole
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.10 and higher, this method
returns a boolean indicating whether BUI apps are set to disallow console
access.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/BBjAppServer_getDisallowConsole.htm)

methods.name: getEndAction
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method is the action that will occur on
normal application termination.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/BBjAppServer_getEndAction.html)

methods.name: getErrAction
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method is the action that will occur on
abnormal application termination.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/BBjAppServer_getErrAction.html)

methods.name: getManageBrowserHistory
methods.docu: In BBj 16.00 and higher, this method returns a boolean indicating whether BUI will manage browser history. The default value is `false`.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/BBjAppServer_getManageBrowserHistory.htm)

methods.name: getOmitBasisCss
methods.docu:
In
BBj 17.00 and higher, this method returns a boolean indicating whether
BUI apps should be run without the default BASIS CSS. The default value
is false.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/BBjAppServer_getOmitBasisCss.htm)

methods.name: getSecure
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.10 and higher, this method returns a boolean indicating whether
BUI apps should be run in secure mode. The default value is false.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/BBjAppServer_getSecure.htm)

methods.name: getSessionTimeout
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the length of time in seconds a non-responsive BUI session will be considered active. If the session expires without response, the web tier will send a NET_DROPPED error back to the server. The default value is 300 seconds (5 minutes). -1 corresponds to no timeout.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver_getsessiontimeout.html)

methods.name: getShowBrowserWarning
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns a boolean indicating whether
to display a browser warning the first time the user attempts to run a
BUI application in Internet Explorer 8. The default value is true.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver_getshowbrowserwarning.html)

methods.name: getShowClientConfirmationDialog
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, this methods returns a boolean indicating whether to display a confirmation dialog when the user attempts to leave the application's page. The default value is `true`.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver_getshowclientconfirmationdialog.html)

methods.name: getStaticResource
methods.docu:
In BBj 16.00 and higher, this method returns an existing defined [BBjResourceUrl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjresourceurl/BBjResourceUrl.html) static
resource.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/BBjAppServer_getStaticResource.htm)

methods.name: getStaticResource
methods.docu:
In BBj 16.00 and higher, this method returns an existing defined [BBjResourceUrl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjresourceurl/BBjResourceUrl.html) static
resource.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/BBjAppServer_getStaticResource.htm)

methods.name: getStaticResources
methods.docu:
**In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns
a [BBjVector](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjvector/bbjvector.htm) of all defined
[BBjResourceUrl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjresourceurl/BBjResourceUrl.html) static resources
(style sheets and images).**[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver_getstaticresources.html)

methods.name: getStaticResources
methods.docu:
**In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns

[BBjResourceUrl](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjresourceurl/BBjResourceUrl.html) static resources
(style sheets and images).**[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver_getstaticresources.html)

methods.name: isPublished
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, returns a boolean indicating whether a given
[BBjApplication](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/bbjapplication.htm) is in
the set of currently published applications.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver_ispublished.html)

methods.name: isRunning
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns a boolean indicating whether the [BBjAppServer](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver.html) is currently running.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver_isrunning.html)

methods.name: makeEmptyAppConfig
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns a new, empty [BBjAppConfig](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/bbjappconfig.htm) to configure a [BBjApplication](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/bbjapplication.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver_makeemptyappconfig.html)

methods.name: publish
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method publishes a [BBjApplication](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/bbjapplication.htm) to the [BBjAppServer](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver.html). This makes the application available to users through the web interface.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver_publish.html)

methods.name: removeStaticResource
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, removes a static resource from the set of available static resources.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver_removestaticresource.html)

methods.name: setClientPollInterval
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method sets the length of time in seconds the web server will wait for the next command from BBjServices. If the web server does not receive a command from the server in the configured time period, it will send a heartbeat to the browser.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver_setclientpollinterval.html)

methods.name: setDevelopmentMode
methods.docu:
In BBj 16.00 and higher, this
method sets whether BUI apps should be run in development mode by default
.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/BBjAppServer_setDevelopmentMode.htm)

methods.name: setDisallowConsole
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.10 and higher, this method
sets whether BUI apps will disallow console access.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/BBjAppServer_setDisallowConsole.htm)

methods.name: setEndAction
methods.docu: In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method sets the action that will occur on normal application termination.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/BBjAppServer_setEndAction.html)

methods.name: setErrAction
methods.docu: In BBj 14.00, this method sets the action that will occur on abnormal application termination.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/BBjAppServer_setErrAction.html)

methods.name: setManageBrowserHistory
methods.docu:
In BBj 16.00 and higher,
this method
sets whether BUI should manage browser history by default.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/BBjAppServer_setManageBrowserHistory.htm)

methods.name: setOmitBasisCss
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method sets whether BUI apps should be run without
the default BASIS CSS.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/BBjAppServer_setOmitBasisCss.htm)

methods.name: setSecure
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.10 and higher, this method sets whether BUI apps should be
run in secure mode. The default value is false.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/BBjAppServer_setSecure.htm)

methods.name: setSessionTimeout
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, sets the length of time in seconds a non-responsive
BUI session will be considered active. If the session expires without
response, the web tier will send a NET_DROPPED error back to the server;
-1 corresponds to no timeout.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver_setsessiontimeout.html)

methods.name: setShowBrowserWarning
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, sets whether to display a browser warning the
first time the user attempts to run a BUI module in Internet Explorer
8.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver_setshowbrowserwarning.html)

methods.name: setShowClientConfirmationDialog
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, sets whether to display a confirmation dialog when the user attempts to leave the application's page.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver_setshowclientconfirmationdialog.html)

methods.name: start
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method starts the [BBjAppServer](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver.html). Any applications published to the BBjAppServer will be accessible.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver_start.html)

methods.name: stop
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method stops the [BBjAppServer](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver.html).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver_stop.html)

methods.name: unpublish
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method removes the named [BBjApplication](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/bbjapplication.htm) from the set of published applications.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver_unpublish.html)

methods.name: updateApplicationIcon
methods.docu: In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method updates the contents of the icon given by `url` to contain the contents of the file given by `iconFileName`.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappserver/bbjappserver_updateapplicationicon.html)

classes.name: BBjString
classes.docu:
In BBj 7.00
and higher, the BBjString object defines an object-oriented interface
to traditional BBx strings. It implements most of the methods defined
by [java.lang.String](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/17/docs/api/java.base/java/lang/String.html). This API is primarily designed to facilitate interaction
with Java libraries.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString.htm)

methods.name: charAt
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns the char value at the specified
index. An index ranges from 0 to [BBjString::length()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_length.htm)
- 1. The first char value of the sequence is at index 0, the next at index
1, and so on, as for array indexing.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_charAt.htm)

methods.name: codePointAt
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher,
this method r
eturns the
character (Unicode code point) at the specified index. The index refers
to char values (Unicode code units) and ranges from 0 to [BBjString::length()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_length.htm) -
1.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_codePointAt.htm)

methods.name: codePointBefore
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher,
this method r
eturns the
character (Unicode code point) before the specified index. The index refers
to char values (Unicode code units) and ranges from 1 to [BBjString::length()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_length.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_codePointBefore.htm)

methods.name: codePointCount
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher,
this method returns the
number of Unicode code points in the specified text range of this String.
The text range begins at the specified beginIndex and extends to the char
at index endIndex - 1. Thus the length (in chars) of the text range is
endIndex-beginIndex. Unpaired surrogates within the text range count as
one code point each.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_codePointCount.htm)

methods.name: compareTo
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this
method compares
two strings lexicographically. The comparison is based on the Unicode
value of each character in the strings. The character sequence represented
by this String object is compared lexicographically to the character sequence
represented by the argument string. The result is a negative integer if
this String object lexicographically precedes the argument string. The
result is a positive integer if this String object lexicographically follows
the argument string. The result is zero if the strings are equal; compareTo
returns 0 exactly when the [BBjString::equals(Object)](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_equals.htm) method
would return true.

This is the definition of lexicographic ordering.
If two strings are different, then either they have different characters
at some index that is a valid index for both strings, or their lengths
are different, or both. If they have different characters at one or more
index positions, let k be the smallest such index;
then the string whose character at position k has the smaller value,
as determined by using the < operator, lexicographically precedes the
other string. In this case, compareTo returns the difference of the two
character values at position k in the two string -- that is, the value:

this.charAt(k)-anotherString.charAt(k)

If there is no index position at which they
differ, then the shorter string lexicographically precedes the longer
string. In this case, compareTo returns the difference of the lengths
of the strings -- that is, the value:

this.length()-anotherString.length()[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_compareTo.htm)

methods.name: compareToIgnoreCase
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this
method compares
two strings lexicographically, ignoring case differences. This method
returns an integer whose sign is that of calling [BBjString::compareTo(String)](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_compareTo.htm) with
normalized versions of the strings where case differences have been eliminated
by calling Character.toLowerCase(Character.toUpperCase(character)) on
each character.

Note that this method
does *not* take locale into account,
and will result in an unsatisfactory ordering for certain locales. The
java.text package provides *collators* to allow locale-sensitive
ordering.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_compareToIgnoreCase.htm)

methods.name: concat
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method concatenates the specified string
to the end of this string.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_concat.htm)

methods.name: contains
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns true if and only if this
string contains the specified sequence of char values.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_contains.htm)

methods.name: contentEquals
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method compares
this string to the specified CharSequence or StringBuffer. The result
is true if and only if this String represents the same sequence of char
values as the specified sequence. Note that if the CharSequence is a StringBuffer
then the method synchronizes on it.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_contentEquals.htm)

methods.name: contentEquals
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method compares
this string to the specified CharSequence or StringBuffer. The result
is true if and only if this String represents the same sequence of char
values as the specified sequence. Note that if the CharSequence is a StringBuffer
then the method synchronizes on it.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_contentEquals.htm)

methods.name: endsWith
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method tests if this string ends with the
specified suffix.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_endsWith.htm)

methods.name: equals
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method compares this string
to the specified object. The result is true if and only if the argument
is not null and is a String object that represents the same sequence of
characters as this object.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_equals.htm)

methods.name: equalsIgnoreCase
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this
method compares
this String to another String, ignoring case considerations. Two strings
are considered equal ignoring case if they are of the same length and
corresponding characters in the two strings are equal ignoring case. Two
characters c1 and c2 are considered the same ignoring case if at least
one of the following is true:

- The two
characters are the same (as compared by the == operator)
- Applying
the method Character.toUpperCase(char) to each character produces
the same result
- Applying
the method Character.toLowerCase(char) to each character produces
the same result[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_equalsIgnoreCase.htm)

methods.name: getBytes
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this
method encodes this String into a sequence of bytes
using the platform's default charset, storing the result into a new byte
array. The behavior of this method when this string cannot be encoded
in the default charset is unspecified.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_getBytes.htm)
