methods.name: getChars
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this
method copies
characters from this string into the destination character array.

The first character to be copied is at index srcBegin;
the last character to be copied is at index srcEnd-1 (thus the total number
of characters to be copied is srcEnd-srcBegin). The characters are copied
into the subarray of dst starting at index dstBegin and ending at index:

dstBegin
+ (srcEnd-srcBegin) - 1[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_getChars.htm)

methods.name: hashCode
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns
a hash code for this string. The hash code for a String object is computed
as

s[0]*31^(n-1)
+ s[1]*31^(n-2) + ... + s[n-1]

using int arithmetic, where s[
i] is the 
ith character of the string, n is the length of the
string, and ^ indicates exponentiation. (The hash value of the empty string
is zero.)[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_hashCode.htm)

methods.name: indent
methods.docu: In BBj 23.04 and higher, this method adjusts the indentation of each line of this string based on the value of n, and normalizes line termination characters.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_indent.htm)

methods.name: intern
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns a canonical representation
for the string object.

A pool of strings, initially empty, is maintained
privately by the class String.

When the intern method is invoked, if the pool already
contains a string equal to this String object as determined by the [BBjString::equals(Object)](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_equals.htm) method, then the string
from the pool is returned. Otherwise, this String object is added to the
pool and a reference to this String object is returned.

It follows that for any two strings s and t, s.intern()
== t.intern() is true if and only if s.equals(t) is true.

All literal strings
and string-valued constant expressions are interned. String literals are
defined in section 3.10.5 of the The
Java™ Language Specification.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_intern.htm)

methods.name: isBlank
methods.docu: In BBj 23.04 and higher, this method returns true if this string is empty or contains only [white space](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/17/docs/api/java.base/java/lang/Character.html#isWhitespace(int)) characters, otherwise returns false.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_isBlank.htm)

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns true if, and only if [BBjString::length()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_length.htm)
is 0.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_isEmpty.htm)

methods.name: lastIndexOf
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this
method returns the index within this string of the
last occurrence of the specified character. For values of ch in the range
from 0 to 0xFFFF (inclusive), the index (in Unicode code units) returned
is the largest value k such that: `this.charAt(k)
== ch` is true. For other
values of ch, it is the largest value k such that: `this.codePointAt(k) == ch` is
true. In either case, if no such character occurs in this string, then
-1 is returned. The String is searched backwards starting at the last
character.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_lastIndexOf.htm)

methods.name: length

In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns the length of this string.
The length is equal to the number of Unicode code units in the string.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_length.htm)

methods.name: matches
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this
method tells whether or not this string matches
the given [regular expression](https://docs.oracle.com/javase/8/docs/api/java/util/regex/Pattern.html#sum). An
invocation of this method of the form str.matches(regex) yields exactly
the same result as the expression [Pattern](https://docs.oracle.com/javase/8/docs/api/java/util/regex/Pattern.html).[matches(regex, str)](https://docs.oracle.com/javase/8/docs/api/java/util/regex/Pattern.html#matches-java.lang.String-java.lang.CharSequence-).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_matches.htm)

methods.name: offsetByCodePoints
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this
method returns the index within this String that
is offset from the given index by codePointOffset code points. Unpaired
surrogates within the text range given by index and codePointOffset count
as one code point each.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_offsetByCodePoints.htm)

methods.name: regionMatches
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this
method tests
if two string regions are equal.

A substring of this String object is compared to
a substring of the argument other. The result is true if these substrings
represent identical character sequences. The substring of this String
object to be compared begins at index toffset and has length len. The
substring of other to be compared begins at index ooffset and has length
len. The result is false if and only if at least one of the following
is true:

- toffset
is negative.
- ooffset
is negative.
- toffset+len
is greater than the length of this String object.
- ooffset+len
is greater than the length of the other argument.
- ignoreCase
is false and there is some nonnegative integer k less than len such
that:
`this.charAt(toffset+k) != other.charAt(ooffset+k)`
- ignoreCase
is true and there is some nonnegative integer k less than len such
that:
`Character.toLowerCase(this.charAt(toffset+k)) != Character.toLowerCase(other.charAt(ooffset+k))`
and:
`Character.toUpperCase(this.charAt(toffset+k)) != Character.toUpperCase(other.charAt(ooffset+k))`[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_regionMatches.htm)

methods.name: repeat
methods.docu: In BBj 23.04 and higher, this method returns a string whose value is the concatenation of this string repeated count times. If this string is empty or count is zero then the empty string is returned.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_repeat.htm)

methods.name: replace
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this
method replaces each substring of this string that
matches the literal target sequence with the specified literal replacement
sequence. The replacement proceeds from the beginning of the string to
the end, for example, replacing "aa" with "b" in the
string "aaa" will result in "ba" rather than "ab".[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_replace.htm)

(\) and dollar signs ($) in the replacement string may cause the results

methods.name: toLowerCase
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this
method converts
all of the characters in this String to lower case using the rules of
the default locale. This is equivalent to calling toLowerCase(Locale.getDefault()).

NOTE: This method is locale sensitive,
and may produce unexpected results if used for strings that are intended
to be interpreted locale independently. Examples are programming language
identifiers, protocol keys, and HTML tags. For instance, "TITLE".toLowerCase()
in a Turkish locale returns "t\u0131tle", where '\u0131' is
the LATIN SMALL LETTER DOTLESS I character. To obtain correct results
for locale insensitive strings, use toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_toLowerCase.htm)

methods.name: trim
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this
method returns
a string whose value is this string, with any leading and trailing whitespace
removed.

If this String object represents an empty character
sequence, or the first and last characters of character sequence represented
by this String object both have codes greater than '\u0020' (the space
character), then a reference to this String object is returned.

Otherwise, if there is no character with a code
greater than '\u0020' in the string, then a String object representing
an empty string is returned.

Otherwise, let k be the index of the first
character in the string whose code is greater than '\u0020', and let m be
the index of the last character in the string whose code is greater than
'\u0020'. A String object is returned, representing the substring of this
string that begins with the character at index k and ends with the character
at index m-that
is, the result of this.substring(k, m + 1).

This method may
be used to trim whitespace (as defined above) from the beginning and end
of a string.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_trim.htm)

classes.name: BBjJettyContextConfiguration
classes.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this class allows the configuration of web contexts
within the Jetty Server. This class is used to programmatically configure
these contexts.

Each context can contain a unique set of BBxServlets, BUI applications,
JNLP application and static content.

To access the main BBj context, which is the default context for all
applications, use the [BBjJettyServerConfiguration::getRootContextInfo()](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration_getRootContextInfo.htm)
method.

The context path is the prefix of a URL path that is used to select
the context to which an incoming request is passed.

Typically a URL in a BBxServlet is in the format `http://hostname:8888/contextPath/servlet/servletPath`,
where each of the path elements can be zero or more / separated elements.
If there is no context path, the context is referred to as the root context.
The root context must be configured as '/'.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettycontextconfiguration/BBjJettyContextConfiguration.htm)

methods.name: getPageExtensions
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.11 and higher, this method gets
a comma-separated list of extensions that are associated with [BBJSP
Page](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjsp/page.html)s.

If [BBJSP Page](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjsp/page.html)s
are disabled then this method will return null.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettycontextconfiguration/bbjjettycontextconfiguration_getpageextensions.htm)

methods.name: setPageExtensions
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.20 and higher, this method sets
the extensions that are associated with BBJSP Pages and will be processed
by the page processor.

For example, this can be useful to allow an
existing site based on `.html` files to be processed as a [BBJSP Page](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjsp/page.html), removing the need to rename
the existing files and to relink everything. Existing `.html`
pages could then be enhancement by [BBJSP
Tag Libraries](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjsp/taglibraries.html).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettycontextconfiguration/bbjjettycontextconfiguration_setpageextensions.htm)

methods.name: getCommandExtensions
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.11 and higher, this method gets
a comma-separated list of extensions that are associated with [BBjspCommand](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjsp/BBjspCommand/bbjspcommand.html)s.

If [BBjspCommand](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjsp/BBjspCommand/bbjspcommand.html)s
are disabled, then this method will return null.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettycontextconfiguration/bbjjettycontextconfiguration_getcommandextensions.htm)

methods.name: setCommandExtensions
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.11 and higher, this method sets
the extensions that are associated with [BBjspCommand](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjsp/BBjspCommand/bbjspcommand.html)s
in the context.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettycontextconfiguration/bbjjettycontextconfiguration_setcommandextensions.htm)

methods.name: getDefaultErrorPage

methods.name: getErrorPages
methods.docu: In BBj 19.01 and higher, this method returns a [BBjVector](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjvector/bbjvector.htm) of Strings of all the error codes that have a defined error page.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettycontextconfiguration/BBjJettyContextConfiguration_getErrorPages.htm)

classes.name: BBjEventData
classes.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, BBjEventData provides
access to the data generated by a configured event handler.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjeventdata/BBjEventData.htm)

methods.name: getEventName
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method returns the short descriptive name of the
event that occurred.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjeventdata/BBjEventData_getEventName.htm)

methods.name: getEventType
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method
returns a numeric type identifier for the
event.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjeventdata/BBjEventData_getEventType.htm)

methods.name: getEventId
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method returns
a unique identifier for the event
.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjeventdata/BBjEventData_getEventId.htm)

methods.name: getEventTypeName
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, returns a string
name for the type of event that occurred.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjeventdata/BBjEventData_getEventTypeName.htm)

methods.name: getEventDetail
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method returns
a detailed string containing information about the event that occurred.
Each event type may return a string of a different format depending on
the type of information available from the event.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjeventdata/BBjEventData_getEventDetail.htm)

classes.name: BBjBuiUrlCloseAction

methods.name: getActionTypeString

methods.name: getActionTypeString

methods.name: getAddrCount
methods.docu: In BBj 2.01 and higher, this method returns the number of public programs loaded into memory as resident programs via the [ADDR](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/commands/addr_verb.htm) verb.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjfilesystem/bbjfilesystem_getaddrcount.htm)

methods.name: getCachedCount

methods.name: convertMKeyedToXKeyed
methods.docu: Converts a [MKEYED](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/usr/Files/mkeyed_files.htm) file into an [XKEYED](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/commands/xkeyed_verb.htm) file.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjfilesystem/bbjfilesystem_convertmkeyedtoxkeyed.htm)

methods.name: makeKeySegment
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method creates a [BBjKeySegment](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjkeysegment/bbjkeysegment.htm) object. BBjKeySegment objects are used to construct [BBjKeyInfo](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjkeyinfo/bbjkeyinfo.htm) objects, which can be used to manipulate VKEYED file key chains dynamically.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjfilesystem/bbjfilesystem_makekeysegment.htm)

methods.name: makeKeyInfo

object.The BBjKeyInfo object can be used to manipulate VKEYED file key
chains dynamically.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjfilesystem/bbjfilesystem_makekeyinfo.htm)

methods.name: makeKeyInfo

methods.name: getTriggerData

methods.name: getStoredProcedureData
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns the [BBjStoredProcedureData](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/BBjStoredProcedureData/bbjstoredproceduredata.htm) object.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjfilesystem/bbjfilesystem_getstoredproceduredata.htm)

methods.name: resolvePath
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method returns the fully resolved absolute
path for the specified file name. The file name can be a file relative
to any configured prefix configurations. When a BBx program makes a call
to OPEN passing in a relative path to a file, BBj checks any configured
prefixes to look for the specified file in those locations. This method
returns the full path BBj would use in a call to OPEN.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjfilesystem/BBjFileSystem_resolvePath.htm)

methods.name: getMimeType
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method returns the detected [MIME
type](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Media_type) for the specified filename.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjfilesystem/BBjFileSystem_getMimeType.htm)

methods.name: getInputStream
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method returns a Java [InputStream](https://docs.oracle.com/javase/8/docs/api/java/io/InputStream.html)
for the specified filename.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjfilesystem/BBjFileSystem_getInputStream.htm)

methods.name: getOutputStream
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method returns a Java [OutputStream](https://docs.oracle.com/javase/8/docs/api/java/io/OutputStream.html)
for the specified filename.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjfilesystem/BBjFileSystem_getOutputStream.htm)

methods.name: watchDirectory
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method watches the specified directory
for changes (create, modify, delete), periodically reporting any changes
through the specified callback.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjfilesystem/BBjFileSystem_watchDirectory.htm)

methods.name: watchDirectory
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method watches the specified directory
for changes (create, modify, delete), periodically reporting any changes
through the specified callback.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjfilesystem/BBjFileSystem_watchDirectory.htm)

methods.name: unwatchDirectory
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this
method stops watching the specified directory for changes (create, modify,
delete). This directory must have been previously watched using [BBjFileSystem::watchDirectory](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjfilesystem/BBjFileSystem_watchDirectory.htm).[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/FileSystem/bbjfilesystem/BBjFileSystem_unwatchDirectory.htm)

methods.name: unwatchAllDirectories

classes.name: BBjJavaServletConfiguration
classes.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, the JavaServletConfiguration is used to configure
a Java based servlet within a context.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjavaservletconfiguration/BBjJavaServletConfiguration.htm)

methods.name: getClassName
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method returns the name of the class which
was deployed as a servlet. The class name will be the fully-qualified

methods.name: getParameterValue

specified parameter.

**Parameters:**

**Returns:** the value for the specified parameter

methods.name: deleteParameter

classes.name: BBjMDI
classes.docu:
In BBj 3.00 and higher, the BBjMDI object represents an MDI (Multiple
Document Interface) window used to display all windows created by an application
being run through a thin client. The BBjMDI aggregates an internal BBjTopLevelWindow.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjmdi/bbjmdi.htm)

methods.name: createMDIWindow
methods.docu:
Creates the [BBjMDI](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjmdi/bbjmdi.htm) window used
by the process. The act of creating a BBjMDI window has an effect on the
manner in which new SCALLed versions of BBj display. If the program that
has created a BBjMDI window makes a call of the form:

X = SCALL("bbj ...<someProgram>
....&)

Any windows created by <someProgram> display within the user area
of the BBjMDI window.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjmdi/bbjmdi_createmdiwindow.htm)

methods.name: createMDIWindow

methods.name: getForwardMenuAccelerators
methods.docu: In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns a value describing whether the window argument will forward keystrokes to the [BBjMDI](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjmdi/bbjmdi.htm) parent for consideration as menu accelerators.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjmdi/bbjmdi_getforwardmenuaccelerators.htm)

methods.name: setForwardMenuAccelerators

methods.name: setDefaultMDIMode
methods.docu: In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method sets the default MDIMode that will be used when new BBjSessions are launched within this MDI.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjmdi/bbjmdi_setdefaultmdimode.htm)

methods.name: getDefaultMDIMode

methods.name: closeAll
methods.docu:
attempt to close the MDI Window and all MDI clients within a specified
timeout period. Any client that has registered an MDIClosing
callback will be polled. If any client vetoes the close then this
method immediately returns. If all clients either RELEASE their
Interpreter or else call approveMDIClose() within the specified
timeout then method will terminate the RuntimeMgr. If the timeout
expires before all MDICloseListeners are polled then this method
throws BBjException.IO_ERR

**Parameters:**

- `p_timeoutInSeconds` if zero, wait forever.

**Returns:** boolean returns zero if someone vetoed

methods.name: closeAllClients
methods.docu: same as closeAll except leaves MDI Master up

classes.name: BBjJettyServer
classes.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this class provides an administrator program the
ability to control the running BBJ Web Server.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserver/BBjJettyServer.htm)

methods.name: isRunning
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method returns a boolean value that indicates whether
the Jetty server is running.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserver/BBjJettyServer_isRunning.htm)

methods.name: start
methods.docu: In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method will start the integrated Jetty Server.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserver/BBjJettyServer_start.htm)

methods.name: stop
methods.docu: In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method will stop the integrated Jetty Server.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserver/BBjJettyServer_stop.htm)

methods.name: restart
methods.docu: In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method will restart the integrated Jetty Server.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserver/BBjJettyServer_restart.htm)

methods.name: getContextNames
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method returns a [BBjVector](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjvector/bbjvector.htm)
containing the names of the configured contexts within the integrated
Jetty Server.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserver/BBjJettyServer_getContextNames.htm)

methods.name: getContext
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method returns a [BBjJettyContextController](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjjettycontextcontroller/BBjJettyContextController.htm) that
can control a running context within the integrated Jetty Server.[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserver/BBjJettyServer_getContext.htm)
